author: Rob Nesbit
title: The place to be on a Saturday night
original_content: The place to be on a Saturday night in Hanoi. Might be an idea to let the crowds dissipate after a few hours and wait in a bar, then the fun can begin as the adult-kids go home..........
practical_tips: let the crowds dissipate after a few hours

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: G2Kpauly
title: Cool street
original_content: A popular street in Hanoi to walk down, chill and eat and drink if you want.  It gets more busy on weekends and you will get hustled by every bar restaurant as you walk down. It's pretty narrow too.
drawbacks: get hustled by every bar restaurant

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: MinT
title: Great place!
original_content: Perfect place to drink and enjoy the crowded people go passing by you on the street. The beer, the street foods, everything from here was great.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: alexander
title: Good
original_content: The place to be if you want to party in Ha Noi! By night it is a “walking street”  but given so many scooters and the occasional taxi I wouldn’t exactly say it’s a walking street haha. Music can be very loud - but there are strategic spots along the street where you can still have a conversation
drawbacks: Scooters and taxis on the street

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Lorraine v
title: 10k beer nearly gone

drawbacks: paying tourist prices for bottled beer
practical_tips: probably lot better places to eat

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Michael A
title: Ta Hien Street , the place to be if I’m Hanoi
original_content: Thế street that has incredible numbers and types of food eateries , bars , pubs , gift shops and even boutique hotels . Prices of items sold are value for money , good numbers of service staffs in the Outlets do speak English . Carnival like atmosphere after 6.30 pm right up to mid nite almost daily .
highlights: incredible numbers and types of food eateries

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Ashwin V
title: Fun and eventful
original_content: Worth doing just for the experience. Sit outside on the little stools, cook your own food and enjoy the atmosphere.Food is ordinary in pretty much all the establishments but who cares. Wait for the local police to come and clear the street and move you indoors..............give it a few minutes and you're sitting back outside again.
drawbacks: Wait for the local police to come and clear the street
practical_tips: Sit outside on the little stools

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Rajesh Kumar
title: The best place for night life
original_content: Food here was amazing, i loved the way they  provided a  can of margarine for each table. Each pan had aluminum foil to grill your food and they will change once it get burned. Infact when it was served my son looked at me with a question mark that are we here to cook or to eat. But I must confess it was amazing especially with such a happening street and lovely environment.  While planning for Ta Hien you should come a little early and see the Lake area and take stroll to Ta Hien.
drawbacks: son looked at me with a question mark that are we here to cook or to eat

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: burygirlkeeper
title: Beer street! Lots of bars and cheap meals
original_content: We have eaten here twice and had a lot of drinks. Average price for local bottled beer is 30k no need to pay more. Main courses are 70-150k, vegetarian stuff available. Whether you want a quiet chat or to Rave, you will find something fun.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: epruuu
title: Vibrant
original_content: This is one of the most vibrant places for night life in Hanoi. There are many pubs with their own craft beers. It is extremely crowded. I suggest to visit this area at weekend from Friday evening. Because it is close to the traffic.
highlights: many pubs with their own craft beers
practical_tips: visit this area at weekend from Friday evening

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: digitalroc
title: A cool experience
original_content: Every large Asian city that I have been too has something similar to this, and Ta Hien Street (Beer Street) in Hanoi is no different.  Even though the area was packed, it was still a unique experience walking down the street with all the chaos around.  This place is worth the effort to get to for a drink, enjoy some nightlife, or just walking the street while you are in the Old Quarter.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Amit M
title: Beer
original_content: This street is narrow, no vehicles allowed and has bars and pubs for beer. Its throbbing and full of laughter and music. A lovly place to hang out and have beer and the loal dishes served with a smile. Look out for promotions.  $ 25 is good enough to drink enough beer and eat huge amounts of food.One beeer is $ 1.30. Must visit post 9 pm
highlights: local dishes served with a smile
good enough to drink enough beer and eat huge amounts of food

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: jack M
title: UNIQUE PLACE
original_content: Should have been here in my youth.  Too late now.  In this small street one can find all to please your lascivious lifestyle's loves. Food, beer (LOTS of beer), women, and etc.,etc.Most happening outside as one inches his (her) way up the street (tourists and locals). Boy, to be young again.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Steve_of_N21
title: Ta Hein Beer Street
original_content: Its small and crowded, being only 200 meters long but on the street of Ta Hien there are many bars where you can find variety of Hanoi street foods such as Nem chua, Vietnamese bread and noodles alongside a wider variety of beer that you find in Vietnamese restaurants. Most drinking is done outside on the plastic tables and chairs and although the locals get on fine with the small plastic chairs I struggled to sit on them for any great period of time.
practical_tips: go to the street of Ta Hien
sit on the plastic tables and chairs

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: E R
title: Unique experience that is more than just food.
original_content: Restaurant after restaurant offer wonderful food to locals and tourists, sitting in the street on small chairs. Then at a moment the waitresses call loudly police, police and wrap in few seconds all the tables, with the food and with the small burning stove, with which they heat their soup or make barbeque. All the tourists make fun of the police, taking pictures of them.
drawbacks: tables were wrapped in few seconds
food and stove were left behind

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: chiangmaicharlies
title: Good and Bad here
original_content: Ta Hien Street is great for people watching and taking photos. You can be sure to get a meal or drink here.On the bad side, it's often frantically busy, with motorcycles winding their way through - and LOTS of people. The food is mostly 'tourist food' (chips, pizzas, burgers, etc) and not much (if any) authentic Vietnamese food. People are often rude and pushy here.Mainly for youngsters looking for a laugh and experience.
drawbacks: people are often rude and pushy
practical_tips: mainly for youngsters looking for a laugh and experience

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Abdur Rahman
title: Hip Hop... Vietnamese traditional stret foods with ice cold beer.
original_content: This is the best street for enjoying the complete nightlife of Hanoi. You will find all kinds of Vietnamese traditional street food with ice cold beer.
highlights: all kinds of Vietnamese traditional street food with ice cold beer

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: edenxo1212
title: Ta Hien Street
original_content: YO! Perfect place to grab yourself a drink and enjoy the crowded people go passing by you on the street. The drink, the side dishes, everything from here was great to me

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Srishti Srivastav-Ghate
title: Loved it!
original_content: It's crazy...its chaotic....there are loads of people....loads of two-wheelers...bars all over with outdoor seating on little plastic stools...but its quite an experience.  I would highly recommend grabbing an outdoor seat in one of the numerous bars to just observe and absorb everything.  This spot should not be missed in Hanoi.
highlights: grabbing an outdoor seat in one of the numerous bars
practical_tips: grabbing an outdoor seat in one of the numerous bars to just observe and absorb everything

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: vickizig
title: Yuck
original_content: Pretty gross little street, really.  You can't get through without being jumped on by hundreds of shills for the restaurants, trying to get you to stop.  Yucky food.  Overpriced.  Not really a comfortable experience even just walking down the street.  There are so many other fun areas of the Old Quarter - explore the rest and skip this tourist trap.
practical_tips: Explore the rest and skip this tourist trap

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Annie Hoang
title: Very crownded with pub and beer
original_content: Very crownded with pub and beer. You wanna a place to enjoy Hanoi night life,come here and try some fresh beer, it make your life more beautiful
practical_tips: come here and try some fresh beer

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Samuel Piette
title: Ta Hien Street
original_content: The best street restaurant in Hanoi. A perfect places where you can come and enjoy for the atmosphere as well as the food and the drinks

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Yevonne
title: Good place for dinner
original_content: Came to this place randomly when walking around on the streets. My family and I had dinner here in one of the BBQ restaurant. The food is great and price is reasonable. What surprised us is that the shop owners have to keep away the tables and chairs by the roadside when police patrolling, that's really an interesting experience for us

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Frogtwo
title: A meal in Ta Hien Street
original_content: This street is extremely crowded, one is constantly harrassed by young men wanting you to tke a meal in the restaurant they work for. At the end the meal, a bun cha, was below average. Grab riders work for prostitutes.
drawbacks: meal in the restaurant they work for

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: True Vietnam - Gorgeous Local Experience
title: great place for drinks
original_content: It is a hectic street in Old quarter of Hanoi. There is a ton of beer restaurants surrounding this area. Travelers call it as an international square (Ta hien crosses Luong Ngoc Quyen) because it is where the global residents gather. Draft beer is one of the most famous drinks in this place. The price of one cup of beer is cheap (around 5-10,000 VND)
practical_tips: go to the international square for a lively atmosphere

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: DerriQ
title: People watching
original_content: We came here last Sunday night after the night market.  It was crazy busy and you have to experience it to believe it! I just couldn't believe how many people there were. Its great people watching.  We found a restaurant with a balcony so sat up there and looked down watching the other restaurants trying to get people to stop and eat there. It was funny to watch.  After a bite to eat we moved on to a bar on the street and sat people watching for a while.  We even saw a whole family of bananas (the fruit printed clothing you see at the markets) walk on by which was a funny site and great photo opportunity!
drawbacks: had to experience it to believe it

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Francis B
title: 5 Ta Hien
original_content: 5 Ta Hien Street is the best street restaurant in this area. Amazing BBQ set up. I have been to this restaurant several times and it has never disappointed me. If you are looking for non-bar non-club street dining experience 5 Ta Hien offers an authentic experience with very attentive service.
practical_tips: Go to 5 Ta Hien Street for a non-bar non-club street dining experience

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Lana H
title: Not what I was expecting
original_content: Atmosphere and buzz of being amongst so many people great but, to be swamped by bar workers to go into their bar was overwhelming. Even when we sat down they tried ordering our beer and food for us! Food and drink, overpriced. Great for people watching and photos but I would not recommend this place.
highlights: great for people watching and photos
practical_tips: be prepared for aggressive sales tactics

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Anonymous Traveller
title: Go for Atmosphere - Not food or beer!
original_content: We were excited to visit ‘Beer Street’ in Hanoi after some good reviews, it was incredibly busy - which was fine and produced a good atmosphere. However, the food was terrible from 2 different outlets we tried and it all appeared to come from the same kitchen anyway. The beer was not cheap and the whole situation was very rushed and uncomfortable. I’d recommend walking through beer street to sample the atmosphere and then moving on to a nicer restaurant where the beer would be actually be cheaper. If restaurants aren’t your thing and you want street food - there are better places to get much better street food than beer street.
practical_tips: walk through beer street to sample the atmosphere
move on to a nicer restaurant
try other places for better street food

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Sajjad
title: Night Life of Hanoi
original_content: It's a great experience to spend quality time with my buddies in the old quarter of Hanoi. All foreigners spend a great time with their like minded buddies with Hanoi beer and snacks.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Tania W
title: Gotta go!
original_content: This street at night on the weekends becomes a market. It is a must do in Hanoi! The usual stuff for sale but just a cool vibe.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Epic-Traveller
title: Excellent
original_content: You get street food all over South East Asia and you can get street beer in beer street.D7,000 for half a pint of Tiger is absolutely pennies. Just outside the Hogaarden Pub a lady sits there with a keg selling 7k beers.
practical_tips: Try the street beer in Beer Street

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: garybush
title: It’s Ok For A Couple of Beers
original_content: We visited Ta Hien Beer St mid afternoon, it wasn’t very busy so the bar’s hawkers were busy trying to get your business. At the end of the day it’s a lane way with a bunch of bars and small restaurants, with several of the bars serving their own home brew, straight from the keg. The beers were 10,000 Dong ($0.60 AUD). The beer was refreshing given the heat of the afternoon. Most of the bars are staffed by young men who can be a touch over the top of passers by,,trying to lure them into their bar.We didn’t try any food, but what we saw come out appeared to be standard local fare.It’s worth a visit when in the Old Quarter, and I’m sure that it gets busy at night and would have a great atmosphere.
drawbacks: hawkers were busy trying to get your business
young men who can be a touch over the top of passers by
highlights: refreshing given the heat of the afternoon
several of the bars serving their own home brew, straight from the keg
practical_tips: go when in the Old Quarter
go early for a great atmosphere at night

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Lee C
title: Heart of Hanoi
original_content: Ta Hien is also known / described as food street or beer street and it lives up to its names. During the day the streets are quite quiet but once dark the streets come alive with the copious amount of bars and Small local restaurants. The restaurants may seem grubby and that’s because they are but you will notice they won’t be shy of locals, so give the food a chance and you will be pleasantly surprised.As for the bars the prices are competitive - not cheap but not expensive either. It’s a must see and should be on everyone’s list when visiting Hanoi.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: heeminjeong
title: beer guysss
original_content: I love beer and I decided to go here for Vietnamese beer experience. Saigonbeer is so good here for my last night in Hanoi

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Joe
title: crowded area full of people drinking beers

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Meo Beibi
title: Would you like to have beutiful nails??
original_content: I highly recommend the little shop in Ta Hien street (the best corner for someone that love hanging out at night). Reasonable priceHigh-quality materialsBeautiful young owner

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: winter
title: Very busy and crowded local and foreigners
original_content: Packed with local and tourist every night, here offers cheap beer and food. Cool to hang out and get drunk with friends, but only if you are a party person. Lots of sellers try to sell fruits and donuts, snacks...can be pushy sometimes
drawbacks: Lots of sellers try to sell fruits and donuts, snacks...can be pushy sometimes

After spending a few minutes walking around in the street, we decided to go around in the Old Quarter away from this street and explore it ourselves. We ended up eating a very delicious dish from a local street food store.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: ZBH88
title: Awesome and packed
original_content: All you would ever want from a party street. Plentiful food of all tastes and palates. Lots of places to drink also. A great place for both tourists and locals especially at the weekends when everyone seems to come out.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: David H
title: Crazy, fun street
original_content: Went along to have a look and a few beers. The atmosphere is crazy. Found a bar 3/4 the way up with bar stools instead of tiny little plastic stools. Watched the passing walking traffic and the many motorbikes squeezing through. Worth a visit.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Emily Levert
title: Must come if you r in Hanoi

practical_tips: go to the street for local food and drinks

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Jalal Iqbal
title: bright and colourful street
original_content: i loved the street and the vibe there.  very bright and colorful. lots of colorful shops and at night a festive look.  crowded and full of local and tourists. a bit loud and many bars and cafes around.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Keshav Khushalani
title: Night Out

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: JnVSydney
title: Loud... crowded and pushy vendors
original_content: We first walked through during the day quite a calm atmosphere, minimal scooters, however it was peak time for deliveries, came back at night to see what the fuss is about.We found it to be louder than else where, (and believe me that is loud), incredibly crowded with visitors, and vey pushy spruikers, we made it to the end in one piece, and from then on we hung out in the quieter end of old town (if there is such a thing), South of Cửa Ô Quan Chưởng (Hanoi Old City Gate) around Phố Mã Mây, (street), the food is cheaper, as well as the beer, if you are adventurous there are beer vendors on the street, with a keg and a few seats selling a glass for 5.000vn (thats right about US$0.22) See review of old quarter, for more info.

try the beer vendors on the street

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Ирина И

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Geofrey Peterson
title: Fun fun fun!

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Ray M
title: Chaos but fun
original_content: Street vendors take over the streets with tables and chairs. Very busy with foot traffic and the occasional motorcycle. This is until the police come! With calls of “Police” the vendors quickly pack up tables and chairs and stand aside while the police pass by. This happened three times during our dinner. Humorous but a little irritating. The food is good and cheap and the atmosphere somewhat charged. Some menu items leave you scratching your head. Be prepared to move about.
drawbacks: some menu items leave you scratching your head

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: KazFitz

author: carloscharmy

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: 814karinar
title: Lively Atmosphere
original_content: Great place to go for some atmosphere. Had a meal and beer at Little Hoi An, we shared the chilli chicken meal, was nice. Then walked further down and had a meal at the Noodle Place. A beef dish, not enough beef, had with a beer. Atmosphere was loud and humming. location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: ducpham27

original_content: So crowded on weekends, so many people, locals and foreigners, want to enjoy the dynamic, boisterous atmosphere

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: BLT
title: Lively street with some great pubs!
original_content: This street also called the "Beer Street" comes to life around 5pm in the evening and is a great place to chill and have fun. Many good restaurants around here most of which have a happy hour in the evenings.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: 19106secret
title: Busy street
original_content: We came here at night, and it was crowded with both local and foreigners. We took some street food, beer, it was nice. And then walking around here and see something. Good experience.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: John v
title: Po Ta Hien/ Ta Hien street/ Beer street
original_content: Pho Ta Hien/ Ta Hien street/ Beer street comes to live about 17pm. In the morning you can have  western and Vietnamese breakfast. You can have luch and/or an early dinner. But  the real action starts about 17pm and lasts  until 00.00 and in the weekend even until later. On Saturday its very crowded. Even the surroundings street are very crowded.This narrow street is full of pubs and restaurants. It seems narrower when the big melting pot  of tourists and locals are packed together on the sidewalk. Sitting on the low stools and at the small low tables. It can get so busy that  there is only a very narrow lane to walk. Some people will/would say "not for me". But for me it was a really pleasant atmosphere. Sometimes the promotors can be very pushy. Even when you tell them firmly that you are not interested.This street has also clubs and danceclubs. Sometimes there are street performers.  According to a Vietnamese guy, this street is very expensive for vietnamese standards and the food is below average. He said that the exploiters are overcharging the tourist. He advised us never to pay with a credit card. Try to pay cash. Because they charge 10% bank fee. That is baloney and a rip off. Watch out for pic pockets.I would advise everyone to go this street in the evening. At least once. Dont forget to try the Bia Hoi. The local type of draft beer that is very popular in Vietnam

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Toffee12
title: Great place to catch Soccer / BPL
original_content: I was looking for place to watch soccer on a weekend in Hanoi and what I found was irish pubs that are further off where i were.  Great to have chance across this place while looking for a Truc Bach - great local beer!  There are many pubs and foods there and when i was there at 7, it was barely crowded and when i leave at 11, it was so full in the streets that i could barely walk.Great atmosphere for a drink and food too!

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Flying Dutchman
title: The heaven for street food and beer
original_content: Ta Hien Street ıs the meeting point of Hanoi in the evening. People from all social groups and nationalities, from torusits to locals gather around in this street full of beer bars and sit on the street on small chairs. The street turns into a night life festival and the party continues until the late hours of the night. The prices are cheap the food is tasty and the atmosphere is unique. If you want to geel the heart of Hanoi beating, this is the place you must go.
practical_tips: go to feel the heart of Hanoi beating

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Kristina C
title: Lively and crowded
original_content: Ta Hien street is definitely worth checking out once when you're visiting Hanoi. During the day is not very crazy. But at night everything changes. It's lively and crowded.  The main part is located between Hang Bac Street and Hang Buom Street. There's a fun atmosphere. The bars pretty much only serve bottle beers and light eats (like French fries, peanuts, fried milk, meatball skewers, and other skewers). The crowd is a mix of locals and tourists sitting on low stools at low tables. There are more restaurants and a more western-style bars as you get closer to Hang Buom Street.
practical_tips: go at night for a lively atmosphere

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: ChangBoris
title: Lively and inexpensive
original_content: This is a very lively street with many variety of eateries and clubs. Beers at the eateries starts from Vnd 25k. Very pleasant and cheap night out.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Beesy1950
title: Disappointing to return here
original_content: I guess it was too much to hope that this was still a great place to come for a drink and it was. Draught beer is no longer a feature just overpriced bottles for tourists. I prefer drinking Bia Hoi with locals but this is no longer the place to do that.
drawbacks: draught beer is no longer a feature
no longer the place to drink Bia Hoi with locals
highlights: still a great place to come for a drink

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: purplekitty2016
title: To do in Hanoi-Beer Street
original_content: Ta Hien Street is also known as the 'Beer Street'.  Right at the onset let me tell you it's crowded with foreigners from all over the world sitting outside having their local beer n food at reasonable price.  It essentially wakes up at night (after 6 pm) with what one can call a pub culture. It's fun to just sit outside having a drink, eating some Vietnamese food, listening to music being belted from the pubs, talking to strangers n watching the world go by. U can even shake a leg or two dancing away in one of the happening pubs. The street is narrow n is hardly very long but it is compact with people, pubs n eateries lined up on both sides. Sure to be tried for some fun on one of the nights while in Hanoi n like us might end up going for it for more than one night too 💃
practical_tips: try the local beer and food

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)

Go to the gioi hai san

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Mayank Agarwal
title: Low End Pubs, Cafes n Bars
original_content: Ta Hien Street also called the beer street lies in the center of Old Quarter of Hanoi. It is the place to be past 6 pm. The street is just 200 meters long but it is one of the most crowded streets I have been to, filled with foreign as well as locals alike. Most people just sit on a small-sized plastic chair right on the street, having beer and food while people watching. There are great varieties of beer available and at reasonable prices. We were here for three nights, one-night having beer n people watching, another trying a Hot Pot and on a third night enjoying sitting in one of the better pubs.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Anil L
title: Beer Street
original_content: Ta Hien street is also called a beer street. The place is full of small beer and snack shops. You can sit on small stools on the road and enjoy a beer watching street performances. On every corner, you will find some performances like local dances, live band, dances etc going on. A beer costs around 1-1.5$. Very lively and happening place. Must visit.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: DAVID L
title: Party and Beer Street ...
original_content: What it is in the evening is party and beer drinking street! Lots of locals But seemingly more tourists quaffing down beers and having a good time. Might be right for you?

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Xerxes R
title: Must visit if you are around
original_content: There is a little something for everyone here. Food places are a dime a dozen. Shopping deals can be found as well. Small stalls where you can grab a beer drink it while you stroll through the street. Lively music pouring out from clubs even some restaurants. We had a good time hope you do too. Njy

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Kristen S
title: high bank charge for credit card
original_content: We ate at Tom's Bar on Ta Hien Street in Hanoi and had a nice dinner. Then, when it came time to pay, and we had a MasterCard, they charged us 10% and said it was a bank fee. Many places do not charge any fee if it's not American Express, and if they do, it's max 3%.  It felt like a scam because they noticed we were foreigners, but by that point, we had eaten and were stuck needing to pay.  We asked our hotel as well, and they said they had never heard of a 10% fee for the bank.  We are very disappointed that this is the last experience we had in Vietnam before heading out of the country. I would avoid Tom's.
practical_tips: check with hotel for bank fees

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Benjamin C
title: Neat place, must visit at night

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: huyenht

They serve the good food here as well. It is nice to take a sit, drink beers and enjoy the local dancing or singing here. location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: NawtyStupot
title: CIGARETTE SMOKE. . YUK!
original_content: I hated this place. It was awful at night, crowded with western tourists sitting both inside & outside bars / street cafés on both sides of the street smoking.Walking through at night was simply awful & I found myself gasping for fresh air, yes the smoking was that bad!Now, I get that the Vietnamese smoke in cafés & bars because they always have & until the people running the businesses ban it & enforce the law (passed in Vietnam in 2010 banning smoking in public) then the Vietnamese will continue to smoke but what I don't get is the tourists all gathered together in their hundreds from UK / Europe etc (WHERE SMOKING IS NO LONGER ACCEPTABLE IN CAFÉS & BARS) that suddenly think its OK to do so? How does that work? I found it easy to stop the hawkers promoting their bar / café to me on Ta Hien by asking for a no smoking room! They simply turned around & ran to someone else. A heads up for anyone in Ha Noi old quarter wanting to eat / drink without suffering second hand smoke from people who only care about themselves & have no regard for others inside a bar / café suffering their second hand smoke, head over to GREEN FARM RESTAURANT just 2 streets away from Ta Hien & there you will find a restaurant that is smoke free inside & what a pleasure it is!
practical_tips: ask for a no smoking room
head over to Green Farm Restaurant

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: mmelllyyyy
title: Small Party Street
original_content: If you have been to Ho Chi Minh's Bui Vien Street or Siem Reap's Pub Street or even Bangkok's Khao San Road then you can compare this place with those places I've mentioned above but it's just too small. It's not as huge as those places. But surely, you can have a nice place to party or drink if you're after finding a nice nightlife. People are friendly in this place but of course you have to be careful of your belongings and you need to check out the price twice before ordering them. Ta Hien is walking distance from everything tho and it's usually crowded and packed by locals and tourist which makes it more lively. Go to this place past 8-9pm so you can fully appreciate it. But the sad thing is that, they stop selling drinks by 0100.
drawbacks: Too small compared to other places
Need to be careful of belongings
highlights: Nice place to party or drink

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: nico m
title: Tour

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Nunngo
title: The best place
original_content: The best place for a great look at and a chance to enjoy the night life in Hanoi.  We really enjoyed the entertainment, the local bar scene and dining.  It was awesome to sit and watch the local people having a great time out and about.  This street and several others adjoining attract all sorts, tourists, families, single people, couples and older people.  The Vietnamese know how to have a good time and the 'buzz' in this area is energising and overloading to the senses.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: PacoGlasgow
title: Busy bar area after 9pm
original_content: This is a great area to hang out after 9pm, sit back in one of the local bars and watch the world go by. It gets busy so get there early enough to get a seat in one of the many bars. The area is safe and  has a good mix of people from all parts of the world. Great atmosphere the place is buzzing 7 days a week.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Granules2013
title: Great location for drinks and street food
original_content: Spend many hours each night strolling around the Old Quarter down this street looking for drinking spots and places to snack. Great range of bars and heaps of street food. Very lively and great atmosphere.
practical_tips: Go to the Old Quarter at night for a lively atmosphere and plenty of bars and street food

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: MaiAnh_Nguyen
title: Interesting & fun for the young soul!!
original_content: I've lived in Hanoi almost since I was born, knowing the development of the city with so many more people. My elementary school teacher used to live here that's why I've had the clear memory of the street 20 years ago. It was quiet, but still the Bia Hoi everywhere. Now the city authority has organized the walking streets, with lots more activities and so much noise, it gives the area new life. It is very interesting experience coming here, I think for both tourists and locals as me. I like the idea and hope that things will be well-organized by time.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: thd007
title: vietnam cafes and street food
original_content: part of the old town and near beer corner as well, this is where the vietnam cafes and street food are. must experience the cheap food and drinks.
practical_tips: Must experience the cheap food and drinks

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Michel C
title: The Street! in Hanoi
original_content: The most popular and one of the best example of street for its proposal for tasty north Vietnamese street food.Active quite late

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: AAS619
title: Part of Hanoi experience
original_content: Saturday night on Ta Hien Street is fun, even if you stay for a little while. It is crowded with tourists and locals alike. The streets are lined with tiny stools and everyone squats around equally small tables dining, drinking and socializing. We had dinner in one of the bars, (I can’t remember the name) stopped at a couple of other bars for drinks and watched the crowd, chitchatted with friendly Hanoian girls sitting next to us. Even if you are not a night owl or don’t like big crowds, hang out on Ta Hein, its nice. We didn’t see obnoxious drunks or any kind of fights. Positive vibes were all around.
practical_tips: even if you are not a night owl or don't like big crowds

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Raymond C
title: lively
original_content: Lively place to sit, eat, drink and people gaze. Go for the places where locals sit, they are better value.Toms bar is to be avoided unless you like sitting on rickety stools and being overcharged for beer.
practical_tips: go for the places where locals sit

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: palawanismyhome
title: Wonderful restaurants where locals and tourists eat
original_content: Ta Hien Street is in the Old Quarter and is the place to go to enjoy some of the best food in Hanoi. Restaurants are to be found on each side of the narrow street and small tables with little stools are placed on the street, but you can always dine inside, and maybe this is better as the police come along every night and the restaurant staff remove the tables from the street. Diners are left holding their beer and plates and if they are lucky they will find a seat inside. There are perhaps 20 or more restaurants and while walking along the street restaurant staff shove the menu in your face and invite you to eat. We dined here on five different nights and never had a bad meal. Some of the restaurants are open at lunch time but not all. Could not tell you if they are open for breakfast. Some restaurants ave several different menus and sometimes they will provide you with a meal from another restaurant so they must have some type of agreement.
drawbacks: Police come along every night and remove tables from the street
Restaurant staff shove the menu in your face and invite you to eat
highlights: Enjoy some of the best food in Hanoi
practical_tips: Go early to get a seat

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Marachi72
title: Fun, lively street - Avoid Tom's bar
original_content: I was here on a Friday and Saturday night with a friend. There was lots going on food and drink wise. Loads of Bia Hoi bars - you could grab food from the restaurants next door, perch yourself on a little plastic chair and make friends with your neighbors . There were a few higher end bars which were mainly Vietnamese.For comfort, there were loads of backpacker bar/restaurants with near identical styles and menus to the rest of SE Asia. It also has the most expensive bar in Hanoi - 'Tom's Bar'. I though they were joking when they brought the bill. Tom's hole, so it doesn't really have much of a case for having higher prices than the lakeside rooftops of the classic international hotels.The clubs looked great, but sadly I didn't make it in.

author: Ferguson M
title: Center of Hanoi old town center

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Tri T
title: modern nightlife in old quarter
original_content: Like walking street in Bangkok with many bar and street beer shop. The space was quite crowded and small so that we took seats on the street. A good place to chill for both local and expat because staffs speak english so well and we can attend street performances around Hoan Kiem lake at the weekend.Nice place to see.
drawbacks: The space was quite crowded and small
highlights: Street performances around Hoan Kiem lake
practical_tips: Attend street performances around Hoan Kiem lake at the weekend

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Lester_Ws
title: Exciting place for chatting with friends and the local
original_content: While walking around Hanoi old Quater, we found this site. The space was quite crowded and small so that we took seats on the street. We heard that Ta Hien street and some nearby streets were shut off to traffic at weekends' nights. We had a lot of fun there like cups of cool beer with some locals. They spoke English very well. They told us about street performances around Hoan Kiem lake at the weekend. Nice place to see.
highlights: cups of cool beer with some locals

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Ann-Maree A
title: Great street but don't go to House of Beer
original_content: This is a great little street in Hanoi with loads of options however unfortunately we chose the wrong place to eat. After walking up and down for 10 minutes trying to decide we just made a decision after we got pestered to go into this place. The first sign it was going to be a bad meal was when about 2 minutes after I ordered my meal it was brought to me by someone who was also smoking a cigarette. (I am a smoker but come on) We ordered vegetarian spring rolls and they have to be the worst I have eaten and contained meat. Lucky I am not vegetarian. My beef noodle soup was oily and contained about 2 slices of beef and my husbands stir fry noodles were actual 2 minutes noodles thrown together with some tomatoes and chicken which was meant to be a stir fry. The best thing was the beer because it came from a bottle. We couldn't eat our meal and left hastily to head somewhere else after a few bites of our meals. Very disappointed !
drawbacks: Worst vegetarian spring rolls I have eaten and contained meat
Beef noodle soup was oily and contained about 2 slices of beef
Husband's stir fry noodles were actual 2 minutes noodles thrown together with some tomatoes and chicken

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Jacqui B
title: Ken's at number 5
original_content: We were walking down this amazing food street and needed a snack, we saw the Ken's was full of locals eating charred birds amongst other things. We were asked if we wanted to eat and a makeshift table for 5 was quickly organised. We ordered drinks while looking at the menu, we decided to try the BBQ option. I can only describe the cooking pot as a single camping ring that had liquid gel as the source of heat. A massive amount of raw meats were brought out, one of the guys showed us what to do and then left it to us. The experience was great and the food delicious. Service was the best. Make sure you eat here.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Beata Maria
title: eating street
original_content: the street fool of bars cafes street food and little resturants.the best to come here for lunch or dinner or just to try great Vietnamese cofffee.
practical_tips: come here for lunch or dinner

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Clairejop
title: Expensive at toms
original_content: We only visited one place down here called tom and jerry bar - v. Expensive for Vietnam and they only offered imported beer on their menu? None of the local beers. I think other places along this street would be cheaper. Fun to perch up on a stool outside one of the bars and watch the madness of the busy street. A lot of people hassle you to buy things - be aware!
drawbacks: they only offered imported beer on their menu
a lot of people hassle you to buy things
highlights: Fun to perch up on a stool outside one of the bars and watch the madness of the busy street

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Hannah Q
title: A Must see
original_content: A great bustling street for food and drinks - whether you are here to party or here to just enjoy a drink and something to eat, you should definitely visit this street.
highlights: party or enjoy a drink and something to eat

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Leo_T16
title: Crazy time but lots of fun
original_content: Having great time with my friend and colleague here in 23 Ta Hien. Try local beer and local fruit, especially Truc Bach for beer and Ma Thay (chest nut) for fruit.  Sitting for 4 hours but this place is always crowded and lots of fun.
practical_tips: try local beer and local fruit

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Sharon M
title: Tom's Bar
original_content: Full of life and plenty backpacker wildness. However, best thing about this particular bar was the manager - jerry (as in Tom and?) Anyway, she runs the bar and street with great precision and attention both to detail and her clients. Highly recommended!
highlights: great precision and attention both to detail and her clients

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Kevhusky610
title: Great place for a night
original_content: Great alley to spend a night. You must try the 5000 dong Beers very god for the price. The little barbecued birds half way up the alley are a other great treat don't be put off. Only time we got ripped of in 3 weeks in Vietnam  was at Tom and Jerry's bar towards the top end (Jerrys bar not the Tom side). Make sure you see the price list and do not go on what the girls tell you or the night may be expensive when you get the bill.Kev
practical_tips: don't go on what the girls tell you

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: worldiscoverer
title: Party place
original_content: Totally transforms in the evening especially weekend night market. Lotsa people sitting in small stools enjoying beer and hot pot.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: tonyhD7219KV
title: International Corner
original_content: A great place for hanging out with friends, meeting new people all around the world, drinking and having fun at night. The International Corner is between Ta Hien and Luong Ngoc Quyen Street, famous with Green Pepper Hanoi !
highlights: great place for hanging out with friends
meeting new people all around the world

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: irve2016
title: The happening place
original_content: During the day a shopping strip at night a lively place to be be, join the hundreds of people for a cheap beer or sample one of the many delicious restaurants.15 cent AUD for a beer you can't go wrong join the happy crowds sitting on the small stools on the street drinking a beer watching the world by what more could you ask for? I loved this place.
practical_tips: sit on small stools on the street

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: jeff1955malaysia
title: at night it beomes a food street
original_content: it is at the junction of hang Bo and Ta Hien. At night the whole street transform in a food galore. small tables and chairs and you can order the food all in the menu with pic. prices are a little high compared to other places. there are also a lot of bars along this street.
drawbacks: prices are a little high compared to other places

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Roger S
title: Beer, food and people - what more to have a great evening
original_content: Two nights in Hanoi, two nights at Ta Hien Street. Only 200m from our hotel on Ma Mai. Full of life, noise, beer and street food. At the top end of the street (further away from Beer Corner) is Tom and Jerry's bar ( open on both sides of the road). The staff were brilliant - fun to talk to, attentive and great knowledge of local food. We were there in a tropical downpour - watching the staff carry on serving using umbrellas was a scream
highlights: fun to talk to, attentive and great knowledge of local food
practical_tips: go to Tom and Jerry's bar

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Kevin Frank S
title: Incredible atmosphere that a street has
original_content: i had been to many streets in many cities, i was impressed by this street the most. it was so busy at night, at night the street was blocked up at the weekend for all kind of vehicle and only allowed walkers. And that was a chance for many locals restaurant and bars extended there business by putting out our the plastic stools and tables to serve people who wants to sit outside and the prices are very reasonable . I like this ideal, to sit outside was great you could see so much. There are some street vendors came up to you and ask you to buy  clothes, books, cigarettes,,,so if you do not want buy from them , you just need to say "no" with your friendly smile but decisive then they would leave you there with your own business. When you walk from the beginning to the end of the street you see bars, restaurants, hotels gift shops, coffee shop..... Here and there on this street you still could see many old french style houses were  among those local houses.
drawbacks: some street vendors came up to you and ask you to buy clothes, books, cigarettes
highlights: it was so busy at night
to sit outside was great you could see so much
practical_tips: say no with your friendly smile but decisive
walk from the beginning to the end of the street

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: JasonNguyen24
title: Dont talk much about this, just come and see
original_content: Only 2 minutes from the Hoan Kiem Lake, u will easily find this street. They have many things here. good for seeing

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: colossalboards
title: It's all kinds a crazy - bar street
original_content: This places is nuts!!!!But you have to go, find a bar, get a cheap beer and watch the chaos unfold! Traffic, people, street sellers, noise!!! Just crazy busy, but we enjoyed it :)

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: Lee M
title: Ta Hien Street
original_content: A quiet place during the day, but a very busy place at night. Tons of bars with a lot of people (tourists and locals) drinking everywhere you look. Worth a visit, even if it's just for a beer or 2.
drawbacks: tons of bars with a lot of people

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: ngocdung93
title: Ta Hien Beer Street - Worthy to visit
original_content: Ta Hien Beer Street is mat. Thousands of people concentrate in the intersection and small lanes. They dance, jump and sing. They drink local beer and chit chat. A lot of local people and international tourists, sit on the plastic small chair, a chair becomes the table.It is fun and crazy

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: BallardBeaver
title: Crazy, Crazy Scene on Saturday Night
original_content: Ta Hien Street -- aka Beer Street -- is just an amazing evening scene, especially on Saturday night. Incredibly crowded (not for the claustrophobic) with people sitting clustered on low stools on both sides of the narrow lane, music booming out of bars all around. There's a bar called Khao San Road Pub, but, really, this tops the original Khao San Road for the sheer intensity of the action. And here, the large majority of the patrons are local, not foreign backpackers. Gotta take a walk through, even if you're not into this kind of oover-the-top scene.

location_name: Lake of the Restored Sword (Hoan Kiem Lake)
author: SagarVS
title: Beer Street
original_content: Ta Hien street is also called the Beer street, This street is full of bars and restaurants and hundreds of people sit outside on the street in tiny plastic stools sipping beer. The bars compete with one another in terms of offers to attract customers. It is said that the beer here is fresh and they seldom store it for more than a day. This is a cool place to hang out and socialise with the locals.

author: Myranda B
title: Full of energy, the food is so-so.
original_content: Tahien is a city that never sleeps, always full of energy. The food was just so-so, but drinking a cold Czech beer in the lively crowd was exceptional. It's worth visiting at least once!
highlights: drinking a cold Czech beer in the lively crowd

author: Travel Girl GR
title: Indifferent road
original_content: Road with shops for food and drink.Nothing special since you can find decent stores anywhere else in the city
drawbacks: can find decent stores anywhere else in the city

author: Knuckles
title: Excellent Hanoi Food Tour with Minh
original_content: Excellent Hanoi Food Tour with MinhOur walking food tour with Minh was a real highlight of our time in Hanoi. Minh was informative, relaxed, and incredibly knowledgeable, sharing great insights into the city’s food, culture, and history without ever making it feel formal.What made the experience special was how friendly and genuine he was — it felt more like exploring Hanoi with a friend rather than being led by a tour guide. The food was fantastic, and we discovered places and dishes we would never have found on our own.Highly recommended for anyone wanting an authentic and enjoyable food tour in Hanoi. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
practical_tips: go with a guide like Minh for an authentic experience

author: 黄佳琪
title: Lively beer street for the hustle and bustle of you
original_content: It's a beer street crowded at night, so buzzy that it's almost inch-deep. If you love the hustle and bustle and enjoy the beer culture, it's really worth exploring. However, street solicitation is more common and requires psychological preparation.

author: Mamie F
title: Vibrant Music Bar Street Safe and comfortable
original_content: The ambience is great, the energy is high! The music is pleasant and the environment safe and secure. Bars gather here to pick your favourite tunes and moods, and enjoy one or more great nights~

author: Vy H.
title: Bars in Hanoi, Vietnam
original_content: Fun area to hang out and drink!  Very energetic vibe, lots of music blasting and tons of people.  If you don’t mind the chaos, this place can be lots of fun!
practical_tips: go if you don't mind the chaos

author: TravelingFoodie
title: Fun and worth it
original_content: Ta Hien Beer Street offers a fun and energetic glimpse into Hanoi’s nightlife. We visited in the evening and found the street packed with people sitting on small stools, enjoying beers and street food in a very informal setting. It gets loud and crowded, and vendors can be persistent, but this is all part of the experience. A lively place to stop by if you want to see a youthful, social side of Hanoi.
highlights: fun and energetic glimpse into Hanoi’s nightlife

author: Berte Haul
title: Perfect pit stop by the night market 🍺
original_content: Plenty of seats at 6 p.m., packed by 7! Nearby vendors invite you in but don’t pressure—places fill up fast. Prices are fair, making it perfect for a bite and a beer, a stroll through the night market, and a relaxed drink on the way back.

author: Furchtlos und Treu
title: Worth it
original_content: I can only think of the following: typical Vietnam... go, order beer, sit and watch the hustle and bustle 😅 There is actually always something to see, you get used to the noise level

author: Umberto
title: Worst place we've eaten for 1000000 dong.
original_content: Worst place we've eaten for 1000000 dong. The food was just crap and not worth the price.  Attracted by the name, never again.

author: Lily
title: Backpacker buzz with heart
original_content: We hit Ta Hien Street for cheap eats, cold beers, and spontaneous laughs—and got all three in spades! The energy is infectious, the locals are friendly, and late-night banh mi runs became our group’s favorite ritual. Pure Hanoi chaos, and we loved it!

author: Song Mi-rae
title: Hanoi Old Town
original_content: In the northern and vibrant city of Hanoi, you must walk through the old streets or by cycling. Through narrow, maze-like alleys, shops and the everyday lives of locals who have preserved hundreds of years of history, you can feel the true charm of the city. Especially in the morning sun or in the evening noise, you'll get deeper into the unique atmosphere of Hanoi.
practical_tips: visit in the morning or evening

author: 李强
title: A beer, a bunch of friends, an "international street."
original_content: Towers Street is a backpacker's paradise! We sat on plastic benches in the evening, drinking ice beer for 20k Vietnamese dong per capita, and watching tourists from all over the world talk and laugh. The street kebabs aroma, the music swirling, lively but not noisy. Laughing late into the night with your friends in the evening wind - that's what travel looks like!

author: raybrahms1964
title: Beer Street party section a total abomination!!!
original_content: We first visited Hanoi 12 years ago and absolutely loved the place. We are back here at the moment and this review is solely for the god awful section of beer street that is absolutely horrendous. It's like running a gauntlet with elderly men watching girls dancing on tables wearing next to nothing while you are harassed by boys shoving menus in your face trying to drag you into their bar. I don't know what the hell the authorities were thinking of when they gave their approval to this section of the street. It is an absolute abomination  and has no place in Hanoi. Whoever is responsible for allowing this should hang their heads in shame. If Hanoi continues in this direction and decends into a place akin to Pattaya on acid then we will not return. If the authorities read any reviews on TA like this then they need to sit up and take notice as they are overseeing a transformation that has absolutely no place in beautiful Hanoi!!!
drawbacks: eldery men watching girls dancing on tables wearing next to nothing
harassed by boys shoving menus in your face trying to drag you into their bar

author: Cordy
title: A chaotic & fun date night!
original_content: We grabbed tiny plastic stools, ice-cold Bia Hoi, and just people-watched for hours. It's loud, energetic, and incredibly fun. The perfect place to laughing 😂

author: Nicolette Torso
title: Chaotic, fun, and unforgettable!
original_content: We dove headfirst into the madness of Ta Hien! Sitting on tiny plastic stools, drinking cheap local beer, and soaking up the insane energy was a highlight of our trip. It's loud and crowded :))))

author: Nona D
title: Wild and fun nights
original_content: Ta Hien Street is an absolute must-visit for a fun-loving couple! The energy is electric. We squeezed onto tiny stools, drank cheap, fresh beer, and just soaked in the chaotic, bustling vibe. It’s loud and crowded, but it was one of the most memorable nights of our trip. A truly unique Hanoi experience.

author: MMA Hà Đông
title: Enjoy night life in Hanoi
original_content: Great place to enjoy Hanoi nightlife, there are many private and open bars, especially lively on weekends with walking street with affordable prices and lots of activities. The downside is that it is not for people who like to go to bed early or are allergic to alcoholic drinks
drawbacks: not for people who like to go to bed early
practical_tips: avoid if allergic to alcoholic drinks

author: Paul P
title: Get ready to be pestered
original_content: Noisy and annoying. But I guess you have to experience it if you're in this part of the world!!!Beer is cheaper than UK obviously but slightly pricier than other places nearby.

author: corinne_prevost
title: THE HOT NEIGHBOURHOOD OF HANOI
original_content: We didn't know where the warm neighborhood was we found it while walking. Beers galore + girls + rabateurs. The winning trio on this street. You have to eat, drink and more so affinities.
practical_tips: You have to eat, drink and more

author: akio9jp
title: Nekki Munmun
original_content: It is a drinking district in the heart of Hanoi's Old Quarter, with shops, clubs and bars serving alcohol on both sides of the street, just 200 meters long. There's a lot of pop music going on and it's a Fever. I had the impression that there were more Western tourists than locals. It's for energetic young people, and the over-recent father doesn't feel good.
drawbacks: It's for energetic young people, and the over-recent father doesn't feel good
highlights: shops, clubs and bars serving alcohol

author: 지후 한
title: Perfect combination of authenticity and vibrant atmosphere
original_content: With our friends, we visited Hanoi's Ta'an Street and it was an unforgettable experience! This place is filled with authentic local atmosphere, and the energy of the lively streets in particular captivated us. Drinking local beer and enjoying the bullshit of the street was a really special experience. It was the perfect place to enjoy a variety of foods and drinks and to spend time with friends and friends. Ta'in Street is a place where you can feel the true charm of Hanoi, and I would definitely like to find it again!
highlights: perfect place to enjoy a variety of foods and drinks

author: Kent
title: Street beer so fun
original_content: I come here on weekend one time per month with my friends. 9 life for all guys, street beer, street food, street music - The vibrant is so fun. I love it all :))

author: Willy Sims
title: Cheers to colorful nights
original_content: This vibrant beer street buzzed with life, and we couldn't resist the delicious street food wafting through the air. We sipped cold beers while soaking in the colorful atmosphere, surrounded by laughter and chatter. Each corner offered something new, from mouthwatering snacks to friendly locals eager to share stories. It felt like a celebration every night!

author: Maddie T
title: friendly locals and lively beer streets
original_content: The street is a lively place, full of tourists and friendly locals. We tasted a variety of delicious beers in the small bar and the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant. Although it is somewhat touristy, it is this enthusiasm that gives us a sense of Hanoi's unique charm. The night's lights and laughter were intertwined as if time had stood still. If you come to Hanoi, don't miss this vibrant beer street!
practical_tips: Don't miss this vibrant beer street

author: Giorgio
title: Lovely Nights in Ta Hien
original_content: Traditional architecture took us back to the past, and the lively Cheap Beer Street was perfect for relaxing with budget beers. The lights and vibrant atmosphere made our visit an unforgettable experience in Hanoi. We'll definitely be back!

author: Mamie F
title: Harnoy's Taching Street expedition.
original_content: The atmosphere is great, the bars and stalls are full of lively crowds. As a famous beer street, it feels great to have friends drinking beer together! The locals are also friendly and helpful, making us feel warm. Still, the streets are a little crowded, and sometimes it's hard to find a quiet place to rest. Overall, this is a place to experience!
drawbacks: hard to find a quiet place to rest

author: Amara B
title: Amazingly
original_content: A bustling, bustling place in the heart of the old town. There are so many diverse colors in this place. My sister loves dancing to music with bottles of beer at roadside stalls
highlights: dancing to music with bottles of beer at roadside stalls

author: 周星
title: The usual experience of lively nightlife
original_content: The small bars and stalls down the street offer authentic food and drinks that do give us a hint of the authentic Vietnamese touch. However, the number of tourists makes it difficult to find a quiet corner to enjoy this uniqueness. Although we tasted several local drinks, it wasn't particularly stunning. Overall, it's a great place for tourists who want to feel the nightlife, but don't expect too much.
extracted_spaces: small bars and stalls down the street
drawbacks: difficult to find a quiet corner
highlights: great place for tourists who want to feel the nightlife

author: Jaymee Elf
title: A night of flavor and fun
original_content: We dived into the lively atmosphere, sampling delicious street food and sipping local beer. The vibrant energy was contagious as we mingled with fellow travelers. Laughing and enjoying each bite together made for an unforgettable night filled with flavors and memories we’ll cherish!

author: Germaine Kope
title: The heart of hanoi's nightlife scene
original_content: Ta Hien Street, aptly nicknamed "Beer Street," offers an electric atmosphere after sunset. We loved sitting on tiny plastic stools, enjoying fresh beer and watching the world go by. The mix of locals and travelers created such a vibrant vibe. It's chaotic and crowded, but that's part of its charm. A must-visit for experiencing Hanoi's authentic nightlife.

author: Dot P
title: The vibrant nightlife
original_content: The laughter of locals and fellow travelers filled the air, creating an inviting atmosphere. We shared stories with friendly vendors, discovering hidden gems amidst the chaos. It was the perfect blend of culture and fun.
highlights: perfect blend of culture and fun

author: Adriana
title: Hanoi's Beer Corner
original_content: This bustling beer corner came alive at night with endless rows of tiny plastic stools filled with locals and tourists alike. Sipping fresh beer while people-watching and sampling street food made for an authentic Hanoi experience. The energy here is simply contagious!

author: Blondell C
title: La Rue de la Bière
original_content: Sitting on our little stools, we shared bia hoi with the locals. The atmosphere is electric, especially in the evening. One tip: try street skewers, they are divine with cold beer!
extracted_spaces: The locals' area where we sat

author: ouchene
title: The Pulsating Heart of Hanoi’s Beer Culture! 🍺
original_content: Wow, what an unforgettable evening on Ta Hien Street! This historic alley in the heart of the old quarter has totally thrilled us. The famous Bia Hoi tastes fantastic here, especially when sitting on the typical small plastic chairs. The atmosphere is electrifying - everywhere cheerful people enjoying life! The mix of tradition and modern nightlife is unique. An absolute must for any Hanoi visitor!
highlights: The atmosphere is electrifying - everywhere cheerful people enjoying life!
The mix of tradition and modern nightlife is unique
The famous Bia Hoi tastes fantastic here
practical_tips: An absolute must for any Hanoi visitor!

author: Sue V
title: Load and chaotic
original_content: This place is an assault on the senses. Load music and lights emanating from every venue. Street vendors hassling and hawkers trying to get you in to every bar. Not for the faint hearted.
drawbacks: hawkers trying to get you in to every bar

author: Krisha
title: Vibrant nightlife
original_content: We were swept up in the lively atmosphere of this iconic Hanoi destination.  Inexpensive local beers flowed freely, making it easy to mingle with fellow travelers and soak in the electric ambiance.  The street food stalls lining Ta Hien offered a tempting array of affordable eats, perfect for fueling a night of revelry.

author: Explore37315798840
title: Horrible experience
original_content: We visited a few places like this in Southeast Asia (Siem Reap, Phnom Penh, Saigon) and enjoyed the atmosphere, but this one is very disappointing and vulgar. The cacophony generated by the loudspeakers of the multitude of small bars competing as well as the flappers of the latter (which are more harassing than inviting) pushed us to cross it as quickly as possible and go have fun elsewhere. In addition, we were repeatedly asked what we were looking for by putting videos of young girls undressing under our noses. This is a shame because it projects a negative image of the city.
drawbacks: repeatedly asked what we were looking for

author: Shtarker
title: Sheer Craziness
original_content: Visited "beer street" in Hanoi's old quarter on a Saturday night.Although we have watched it on YouTube, the crowed, loud technology music & every second vendor trying to drag you into their bar or restaurant was something that we are totally unprepared for.  Finally we sat down at Coco Bar for a drink, seems to have less people around that area, but still have to constantly fighting off street vendors trying to sell items to us, one of them was a kid looked under 10 yrs old selling cigarettes.Definitely not our cup of tea!
drawbacks: Street vendors trying to sell items

author: Crumpled Nomad | Travel Intelligence
title: Busy busy busy street on a Saturday night
original_content: A famous street in Hanoi where one can find many pubs, bars and drinking holes along the street. They even sat on the road with low chairs sipping ice cold beers. It was extremely busy and packed on a Saturday night and as I walked along, I was constantly bombarded with people touting. I found this rather unpleasant and tried to walk as fast as possible. It’s just not something for me but it’s strictly my opinion. I’m sure many will find this place interesting. For someone who’s not into drinking and loud music, this may not be the place for you. But I enjoyed walking along it, just once to soak in the bustling atmosphere.

author: Sshuddho G
title: A diff experience..
original_content: ..cold and fresh draught beer sitting on small street side chairs after a long day of touring can be quite therapeutic..cheers

author: BrakiWorldTraveler
title: Pattaya style party area
original_content: This street is commonly known as Hanoi Beer street and is set in the northern part of Old Quarter. It comes alive at night with dozens of cafes, night clubs, eateries, massage parlors, etc....much reminding on such in Pattaya or Phuket.Music is very loud, coming from every, tiny and small club one by another, so while walking you hear only unrecognizable mixed music noise. We just walked through without any desire to sit somewhere, even our teenage daughter didn't like it.
practical_tips: avoid if you don't like loud music

author: Departure48409439286
title: A wonderful experience at Hoang restaurant
original_content: The restaurant serves delicious food, super delicious food, friendly and enthusiastic staff. Daisy was the one who took care of my table, she was very kind and friendly. Will recommend the restaurant to many of my friends and will come back again and again

author: PW14513
title: chill chill
original_content: Busy street and ideal place to hang out with my friends. There were a lot of souvenirs shops and restaurants surrounding
highlights: Ideal place to hang out with friends
practical_tips: Go to the surrounding souvenirs shops and restaurants

author: Rutland Auckland
title: Not worth the effort to go to - it’s just hyped up
original_content: Sorry not for us. A tourist trap. Overpriced. Underwhelming. It reminded us of Magaluf or some other seedy European nightlife.Save your money and go to any of the myriad of better places
practical_tips: Save your money and go to any of the myriad of better places

author: Mobile40517000222
title: Bia street for travelers
original_content: Such an interesting place for gathering and chilling with friends. Good for Hanoian and travelers to enjoy the bia hoi

author: HIROYUKI SHIMIZU
title: Extraordinary
original_content: I went there on a Friday and it was crowded with tourists and locals. Cars and motorbikes were passing by nearby so we had to sit and drink on the edge of the seats, music was blaring, people from all over the world, vendors... it was chaos. If you want to feel the power and heat of Asia, this is the place to go.
drawbacks: had to sit and drink on the edge of the seats
highlights: feel the power and heat of Asia

author: Siddeeque Hassan
title: Beer + Positivity = Ta Hian
original_content: Ta Hien Corner is also known as The Beer Street, is a great food street. The weekends in Ta Hien is so much positive vibe and positivity. A great place of weekend hangout for both tourists and natives. A must visit place for sure.

author: Scott W
title: Beer Street
original_content: This place is amazing, bars everywhere and the sights and sounds are an assault on your senses. A great place to go for a drink with lots of 'happy hour' offers.
highlights: great place to go for a drink

author: Vthc4
title: Great atmosphere
original_content: We went on a Thursday evening and it was bustling - a total change of the street in the day. Great atmosphere with loud music with many diners seated on both sides of the street.

author: SK
title: Nice area to visit for the nighttime
original_content: One of the must-go, it is crowded and fun. Just remember to not drink too much and make sure you always check prices.

author: Jacky29292
title: Nice place but very crowdes
original_content: Njce place for drink beer and have some food. The price ia a bit expensive. It is very crowded but fun to go there

author: The Baobab Republic
title: Awesome
original_content: One of the places you must visit when coming to Hanoi is the old quarter of Ta Hien.  Here is famous for the shops selling food, drinks, bars and many specialties of Hanoi.  And there are many delicious dishes.  And Banh Mi Co Nga is one of the dishes that you should try.  A little pate, sausage, chicken eggs are stir-fried in a pan with a little fat.  Add a little soy sauce and chili, serve with bread.  A great experience in the old town.

author: alebeth
title: It’s a no from me
original_content: Also known as beer street. This place is crazy busy and reminds me of Bangla Rd, Thailand. I really disliked this place and didn’t enjoy it. Maybe better suited to a younger crowd who wants to get on the drink and balloons.

author: EdM
title: Everything is happening
original_content: A great spot to have a beer and watch the action. We found the junction was better than the bars higher up the street. And cheaper

author: Pulkit C
title: Crazy party street, unlike seen anywhere else!
original_content: Oh what a street. Extremely crowded, beer revellers filling on the street sitting on small benches. What a vibe! Must visit if you love beer or not. The place to party in Hanoi. Street was alive till midnight on a weekday. Locals as well tourists flocked onto the small drinking joints lining the street, my top rated place in Hanoi for night life!
highlights: Top rated place in Hanoi for night life

author: Rob Nesbit
title: The place to be on a Saturday night
original_content: The place to be on a Saturday night in Hanoi. Might be an idea to let the crowds dissipate after a few hours and wait in a bar, then the fun can begin as the adult-kids go home..........
practical_tips: let the crowds dissipate after a few hours

author: G2Kpauly
title: Cool street
original_content: A popular street in Hanoi to walk down, chill and eat and drink if you want.  It gets more busy on weekends and you will get hustled by every bar restaurant as you walk down. It's pretty narrow too.
drawbacks: get hustled by every bar restaurant

author: MinT
title: Great place!
original_content: Perfect place to drink and enjoy the crowded people go passing by you on the street. The beer, the street foods, everything from here was great.

author: alexander
title: Good
original_content: The place to be if you want to party in Ha Noi! By night it is a “walking street”  but given so many scooters and the occasional taxi I wouldn’t exactly say it’s a walking street haha. Music can be very loud - but there are strategic spots along the street where you can still have a conversation
drawbacks: Scooters and taxis on the street
practical_tips: Go at night for a party atmosphere
Be aware of scooters and taxis on the street

author: Lorraine v
title: 10k beer nearly gone
original_content: 10 k beer is still available but only at few limited places. Most of busy street paying tourist prices for bottled beer. Busy and interesting but probably lot better places to eat. Loud techno and cigarette smoke if you like that.
drawbacks: paying tourist prices for bottled beer
practical_tips: probably lot better places to eat

author: Michael A
title: Ta Hien Street , the place to be if I’m Hanoi
original_content: Thế street that has incredible numbers and types of food eateries , bars , pubs , gift shops and even boutique hotels . Prices of items sold are value for money , good numbers of service staffs in the Outlets do speak English . Carnival like atmosphere after 6.30 pm right up to mid nite almost daily .
highlights: incredible numbers and types of food eateries

author: Ashwin V
title: Fun and eventful
original_content: Worth doing just for the experience. Sit outside on the little stools, cook your own food and enjoy the atmosphere.Food is ordinary in pretty much all the establishments but who cares. Wait for the local police to come and clear the street and move you indoors..............give it a few minutes and you're sitting back outside again.
drawbacks: Wait for the local police to come and clear the street
practical_tips: Sit outside on the little stools

author: Rajesh Kumar
title: The best place for night life
original_content: Food here was amazing, i loved the way they  provided a  can of margarine for each table. Each pan had aluminum foil to grill your food and they will change once it get burned. Infact when it was served my son looked at me with a question mark that are we here to cook or to eat. But I must confess it was amazing especially with such a happening street and lovely environment.  While planning for Ta Hien you should come a little early and see the Lake area and take stroll to Ta Hien.
drawbacks: son looked at me with a question mark that are we here to cook or to eat

author: burygirlkeeper
title: Beer street! Lots of bars and cheap meals
original_content: We have eaten here twice and had a lot of drinks. Average price for local bottled beer is 30k no need to pay more. Main courses are 70-150k, vegetarian stuff available. Whether you want a quiet chat or to Rave, you will find something fun.

author: epruuu
title: Vibrant
original_content: This is one of the most vibrant places for night life in Hanoi. There are many pubs with their own craft beers. It is extremely crowded. I suggest to visit this area at weekend from Friday evening. Because it is close to the traffic.
highlights: many pubs with their own craft beers
practical_tips: visit this area at weekend from Friday evening

author: digitalroc
title: A cool experience
original_content: Every large Asian city that I have been too has something similar to this, and Ta Hien Street (Beer Street) in Hanoi is no different.  Even though the area was packed, it was still a unique experience walking down the street with all the chaos around.  This place is worth the effort to get to for a drink, enjoy some nightlife, or just walking the street while you are in the Old Quarter.

author: Amit M
title: Beer
original_content: This street is narrow, no vehicles allowed and has bars and pubs for beer. Its throbbing and full of laughter and music.
