sun god was not on the date

author: James O
title: Beautiful Town
original_content: This is a very pleasant place to spend 3 or 4 days, the village itself is a bit of a backpackers hang out so can be lively at times. But that all adds to the charm. It's especially vibrant at the weekend.A few tipsYou don't need a tour or a guide for most attractions, the best of which is Trang An with its spectacularly beautiful waterways, caves, and immense towering landscapes. It offers 4 routes the best of which in my humble opinion is route 1, 9 caves and 4 temples (there only so many temples you can visit with enthusiasm) all routes take circa 3 hours ( you won't notice it go by) with the exception of route 4 at 1 and 1/2 hours. All for $ 10, it's a steal. Skip the tour, get a grab, and save yourself some money and aggregation.The bird reserve is nice, two boat trips included in the ticket. It's not as good as Trang An, but it's good for a morning. Be aware that the ticket office is  circa a a mile from the park, so if you arrive by taxi, make sure they wait for you to get your ticket and drive you the rest of the way. It would be an arduous walk.We also visited the bear sanctuary, which is a worthy cause and worth a visit, albeit that it is a bit away from Tan Coc.Lots of temples and pagodas if that's what you're into, and a mountain viewpoint with 500 uneven steps to a seriously overcrowded photo opportunity,  if that's what you like.People everywhere selling tours and convincing you you need them ! Honestly, you don't, and with a tour, you are always on someone else's agenda and timeline.We stayed in Tam Coc Golden Sky homestay which was very good and centrally located, and the best food we found was directly across from the Tam Coc boating area and next to the karaoke bus that serves really really good rotisserie duck and really cheap but good draft beer.Well worth a visit enjoy.
practical_tips: save yourself some money and aggregation
be aware of ticket office location

author: macpan
title: nice boat trip
original_content: nice boat trip, of course super touristy. I found it quite crowded on the river, but we knew that from the outset. The scenery during the ride is quite nice, but nothing unforgettablely spectacular. However, it's kind of part of being around Ninh Binh.

author: bethany w
title: A truly pleasant place.
original_content: Tam coc was potentially my favourite place in Vietnam. It has a town feel to it, which makes a change from the hustle and bustle of the big cities, but still has everything accessible to it. There were so many amazing restaurants, supermarkets, cafes, etc. Banana Tree Hostel provides a great hang out and chill spot, Sisterfields serves an exceptional lunch and Trang An National Park boat tour was a fantastic experience. Strongly recommend visiting if you have the chance!
highlights: great hang out and chill spot
practical_tips: visit if you have the chance

author: Horizon Hugo
title: Super nice but
original_content: We started our tour at 4:15pm , therefore when we arrived for the temple, the furthest point and only temple to visit on this tour, it was closed. So we directly turn around and went back to the boat station.Other than that, this tour is very very beautiful ! You won't regret doing it.
drawbacks: the furthest point and only temple to visit on this tour was closed

author: Aiden L
title: Awesome place
original_content: I totally recommend checking out this awesome place. You can see the rice fields, ducks, goats, and monkeys while you're on the boat. The water was super clear, so I could see right through it. The natural beauty was off the charts. While on the boat, we can soak in the views of rock peaks, rice paddies, and caves. It's a must-see experience, for real!

author: DRINK AND F
title: nice
original_content: great foods, awsome drinkswelcome to Drink& foods Traditional in Tam Cocnice place, friendly staff,  good services ...

author: Hayley B
title: Beautiful
original_content: This place is so beautiful. You just want to jump into the emerald waters and swim. We couldn’t visit all the caves because of storm Yagi, but the trip down the river did not disappoint. We took a late trip and were therefore the last people on the river… it was so peaceful.
drawbacks: storm Yagi prevented visiting all caves

author: Andrea
title: Beautiful place
original_content: You can make many different excursions and all very pleasant: the classic boat ride passing through caves, visit the ancient capital Hoa Lu, climb to see the view at Mua Cave
practical_tips: visit the ancient capital Hoa Lu
climb to see the view at Mua Cave

author: cb512016
title: Relaxing ride down tge river
original_content: We arrived and had a 15 minute wait for a boat, it was busy as it was being shut due to typhoon We were Road down the river through the caves and back again it took over an hour but  really enjoyable.Watch out for photographers half way down, they will take your photo and pressure you to by them, just say no thank you if you dont want them.They also try and sell you pictures we liked them and bought two.Remember to tip the rower, we were suggested 100dong, but it is an optional thing.

author: Giulia M
title: Small village, base for area excursions
original_content: For those visiting the area and wanting to do the boat trips of Tam Coc, Trang An, the visit to the Hoa Lu Citadel, the pagoda and Mua Cave, Tam Coc is the ideal base because full of homestays, restaurants, cafes, has everything you need, including ATM, mini market, pharmacy. We stayed in Trang An (which is 6km away) and was too isolated to eat for dinner.Only my surprise, and I still do not explain why, it was all rather deserted, lots of locals but no people around, yet in 3 weeks of Vietnam we always found a large crowd of tourists everywhere
highlights: has everything you need, including ATM, mini market, pharmacy
practical_tips: stay in Tam Coc for boat trips

author: PGMikk
title: A moment of calm
original_content: The scenery is beautiful, although not very wild, but come on, this is a planned tourist area. The water in the second and third caves is clearer and you can see the bottom as well as small fish swimming below, which is very interesting. When you go deep inside, you feel like you leave the civilized human world behind and calm down. However, I was quite uncomfortable when the boatman invited me to buy a painting
drawbacks: uncomfortable when the boatman invited me to buy a painting
highlights: leave the civilized human world behind and calm down

author: Jeroen S
title: Loved biking through the fields!
original_content: As all places, it is a bit touristic. Spending 2 days should do the trick. We did not do the river boats as it looked ridiculous. Way too busy, too expensive and lots of bad reviews.If you have been to Cat Ba en done a boat tour including canoeing then scrap this river tour. Car ba is better and less touristic. We hired a private car for 1,2 million a day to go to three different locations. It was worth it but it’s better to rent directly. The market up of the hotel is between 20% en 40%.Rent bikes or take a hotel that has bikes. Bike riding is nice and easy. Go off track!Tip for when you have kids, Buffalo cave. For 100/150k including a drink you can feed the ducks, fish with a bamboo stick, etc. We spend 1,5 hours but could have spend more time there!
highlights: Rent bikes or take a hotel that has bikes
practical_tips: Rent bikes or take a hotel that has bikes
Tip for when you have kids, Buffalo cave

author: Tamcoc Scenic Area
title: boat ride, view point of Heaven, Cloud Peak
original_content: boat ride, view point of Heaven, Cloud Peak is so amazing view...You should come here to enjoy the most peaceful, natural and comfortable atmosphere.

author: VikingRiviera
title: The Trang An landscape is fascinating
original_content: We went on the 2 hours boat trip through the Trang An Landscape. It was very hot. We were two couples in the boat, plus the rower. It was the most interesting part of what we experienced in Vietnam, the view changed constantly during the trip, we visited several temples and went through several caves. It was a fascinating experience.
highlights: the view changed constantly during the trip
visited several temples and went through several caves
the most interesting part of what we experienced in Vietnam
practical_tips: Go early to avoid the heat

author: Sarah Robinson
title: A perfect blend of nature and culture
original_content: I recently enjoyed a fantastic one-day trip to Tam Coc in Ninh Binh. The boat ride along the Ngo Dong River was mesmerizing, with stunning limestone karsts and serene waters. Passing through the three caves was a unique experience. The visit to Bich Dong Pagoda offered incredible views and a peaceful atmosphere. Cycling around the village allowed us to immerse ourselves in the local culture, surrounded by lush rice paddies and friendly locals. A perfect blend of nature and culture – highly recommended for a day trip!
practical_tips: highly recommended for a day trip

author: Sue
title: Relaxing boat ride through cliffs
original_content: This is one for the rice fields serenity mountains and caves . Be prepared for a bit uncomfortable seating for 1.5 hour but the views compensate for that. Stable water and boat and the wonderful boat rowers make the trip so pleasant . You go underneath the caves ( three ) not inside them . So expectations beware . Not sure what Trang ang tours route offers . The river is stable and the views are of cliffs and trees surrounding . Not one to be missed . I went there as a part of a guided tour by local mint travel WhatsApp +84 94 925 96 75 ) . They were very helpful and professional and no complains at all . This is a nice relaxing place and the boat tour is a must

author: Hà P
title: Enchanting Adventure
original_content: The highlight of the tour was the mesmerizing boat ride through the picturesque Tam Coc waterways, surrounded by towering limestone karsts and lush greenery.

author: Chris B
title: Tam Coc boat trip
original_content: Lovely being rowed through the rice fields, very peaceful just the sound of the oars in the water. We saw goats 🐐 scrambling in the limestone hills on either side and plenty of bird life. The trip lasted about an hour and was “ there and back” rather than a circular tour like Trang An. Very enjoyable in a lovely setting and well worth doing.

author: EleonoraO75
title: Tam Coc Boat Tour and Various Attractions
original_content: The Nihn Bihn area is very rich in things to do and in my opinion deserves a visit of at least two full days. We slept in Tam Coc, a small town with many hotels and many restaurants and we had a very good time. In Tam Coc the main activity is boat tours. We bought a ticket which allowed us to do not only the boat tour but also to visit all the attractions in the Tam Coc area with an electric shuttle. It takes about three hours and in my opinion it's absolutely worth it! Of course the Trang An boat tour is more beautiful, but if you have enough time Tam Coc is also worth a visit! The cost of the ticket is 340 dong per person and you also visit the Thai Vi Temple, Dong Tien, Bich Dong Pagoda. Not to be missed!
highlights: visit all the attractions in the Tam Coc area with an electric shuttle
practical_tips: buy a ticket that allows you to visit all the attractions in the Tam Coc area
visit the Thai Vi Temple, Dong Tien, Bich Dong Pagoda

author: Onas
title: Boat ride
original_content: We took the trip on bamboo boats. The landscape is very beautiful. It's interesting to see how the boats are driven. It lasts around 1h30min.
highlights: interesting to see how the boats are driven

author: Roam20716917383
title: Lovely area to explore
original_content: Beautiful area of outstanding beauty..easy to get around. We didn’t do a tour..just went independent from Hanoi via limo van. Do the trang a boat tour..it’s fabulous and well organised. Route 3 is great with the right amount of caves and temples, we loved it and stayed 4 days. Chilling, walking, cycling and relaxing. Book a place with a pool!! Highly recommend if you have time. 3 days about right. Mua  cave is fab but phew…very tough and hot!  Tam Coc is touristy but small..fab massages and some good food.
highlights: great with the right amount of caves and temples
fab massages and some good food
practical_tips: Book a place with a pool
Do the trang a boat tour

author: WanderingWilbur
title: Wonderful day trip.
original_content: So, for us this was a day trip from Hanoi, taking in the ancient capital of Truong Yen, followed by lunch and a cycle ride, a rowing boat tour down the river, finishing off with a climb up Hoa Lu.All fairly crowded with fellow tourists, but very well worth the effort.Ancient capital: underwhelming.River boat tour: too long in that day's heat (40+, with no wind: draining), but the most amazing scenery.Hoa Lu climb: again, busy, but so well worth the views from the top. Stunning.
drawbacks: too long in that day's heat
highlights: so well worth the views from the top

author: Eva-Marco
title: Unmissable boat trip
original_content: The boat ride along Halong Bay on land is a must in the Tam Coc region. Extremely touristy site, but the scenery (karst sugar loaves, rice fields, etc.) is definitely worth it, even if the views from the sky (by drone) are more impressive than the feeling on the river itself.Long procession lasting around 1h30 of the boats (the rowers handle their oars with their feet!), passing under three quite impressive caves. A beautiful walk!

author: Voyager786978
title: Beautiful boat trip in unique nature
original_content: The landscape is beautiful and worth it, but you are actually supposed to buy something (pictures). And at the end of the boat trip we were asked for a tip, which we would have given willingly. It's a shame, it spoils the mood a bit.
drawbacks: you are actually supposed to buy something

author: Lauretta P
title: Boat trip through the rice fields
original_content: Very relaxing area of Vietnam, boat trip was long but enjoyable, our paddler was sweet and paddled mostly with her feet, the boats are small but very stable. I recommend taking a cushion as the seats are metal and uncomfortable for older people or bad backs. The river way is clean and tranquil

author: Anupama
title: Wonderful boat ride, don’t miss
original_content: The boat ride at Tam Coc through hills and cave grottoes is just lovely. The scenery is beautiful and the boat ride itself really enjoyable.

author: Marco D
title: Unique experience.
original_content: Everything that surrounds it is beautiful and characteristic. The trip on the river will be an indelible memory. Never felt such peace immersed in a surreal environment seen until now only in TV documentaries.To be tried without ifs or buts.SURREAL.
practical_tips: try it without ifs or buts

author: Tracey011
title: 3 night stay in Tam Coc
original_content: We chose to stay in Tam Coc for three nights rather than do a day tour from Hanoi. So glad we did. We organized a 'limo' transfer from Hanoi thro the hotel we booked with in Tam Coc. They run every hour.Day one we arranged a driver who took us to Trang An, amazing,  we were rowed through the waterways and caves and stopped at various temples. Tip...find other people share a boat with, they take 4 at a time. There are three tour options, we choose 2. It was great. Arriving early meant we missed the hoards arriving on the day tours from Hanoi.Next stop was Bai Dinh. Electric buggies to Wizz you around, ancient Buddist temples and modern temples. Huge gold leaf covered bronze Buddha's and great views from the top of the pergola (elevator!) By that stage we were exhausted! Lots of walking plus high humidity. Fabulous day.Staying in Tam Coc meant we could walk to the Tam Coc row boats.  Arriving shortly after 9am meant we missed the crowds again. Glad we did this as well as Trang An as different experience. Loved the foot rowing technique!
practical_tips: find other people to share a boat with

author: Stokie_on_tour
title: Jurassic park done Vietnam style
original_content: A stunningly beautiful place that needs at least three days to explore, incredible views but also full of local life and culture.The boat tour ie a must but hire q bike and get out into the paddyfields, cannot wait to return/

author: Al2go
title: Worth a visit
original_content: The only real reason you would visitTam coc is to do the row boat cruise down the river past all the rice paddies through the caves and beautiful scenery. The restaurants are fairly good.
practical_tips: visit Tam Coc for the row boat cruise

author: Alessandro S
title: Nice boat ride
original_content: You can take quite comfortable boats driven by elderly ladies who row with their feet. You pay 250,000 dong each. There are two people per boat.During the tour you pass through incredible karst formations and under three caves. In some places, herons are seen eating rice in the fields. Interesting.

author: Alexandra
title: Great experience, highly recommended!
original_content: The boat tour was really beautiful! Contrary to what was complained about in previous reviews, we were not pressured to buy anything and no tip was expected from us. Our foot rower spoke a little English and was very friendly. We went on a Saturday morning, didn't have to queue and were able to enjoy the tour to the fullest!

author: Dd
title: A bit of magnificent calm, after Hanoi scooters’ fun madness
original_content: More than an hour rowing boat ride along Ngo Dong River. Magnifique. Also needs to keep your head down when going dark, under caves.
drawbacks: needs to keep your head down when going dark, under caves
practical_tips: keep your head down when going dark, under caves

author: Helena
title: Tam Coc River tour
original_content: Such a peaceful and beautiful place to visit. Drifting on the river amongst the rice fields between the breathtaking mountains. Was definitely an experience and one not to be missed when visiting Ninh Bính province.

author: english ward
title: Halong Bay on Land
original_content: We visited Tam Coc on our couple's trip and were blown away by the stunning beauty of this place. The karst formations rising out of the water looked like something out of a fairy tale. Paddling down the river in a small boat, we felt like we were in our own private paradise. Plus, no need for sea sickness pills! Definitely a must-visit if you're in Ninh Binh.
practical_tips: no need for sea sickness pills

author: Calum
title: Go to Trang An!!
original_content: Save your money and go to Trang An. The scenery is great, and the people rowing their boats row with their feet which is a nice novelty, but you don't stop anywhere and the route back is just a reverse, so you'll see the same things twice. Lastly, and the real downside, is that the lady REPEATEDLY asked for a tip! Never had this anywhere, and prior to her asking one would have been set in stone, as it's a hard job, but that put the money back in my pocket and left a sour taste.
drawbacks: The route back is just a reverse
The lady repeatedly asked for a tip
highlights: The people rowing their boats row with their feet which is a nice novelty
practical_tips: Save your money and go to Trang An

author: DotsGirl2
title: Fun boat ride through three caves
original_content: You get on small boats and are rowed  up the river. There are rice paddy’s along the way and the karst mountains that rise up. You go through three caves and then turn around and go back down the river. The people rowing often use their feet to row. This was a fun experience

author: Angie H
title: Fewer crowds than Trang An
original_content: We did both the boat ride here and Trang An, and this was definitely quieter and more peaceful. The scenery of limestone cliffs might be better at Trang An, but I liked this boat experience better.

author: Nynke
title: Tam Coc? A No for us!
original_content: After we came from the beautiful authentic Pu Luong, Tam Coc was a completely different story. We thought it was very touristy and the area we explored on the scooter was not spectacular. The boat trip in Tam Coc is very overrated because you are in a traffic jam with hundreds of other boats. We left earlier than planned. Vietnam has so many more beautiful places than Tam Coc.

author: Marjory M
title: Beautiful scenery, shame about the demand for tips!!!
original_content: Boat trip scenery is beautiful and despite all the boats we found it enjoyable and serene. Like other reviewers we got asked to buy photos (no hassle) pictures (boat driver) and then our driver kept demanding we tip him! He was so aggressive we took his photo and complained. He was brought back in to speak to us (translated obviously as he only knew 2 words in English - money and tip). We thought we had got a bad driver but it seems to be a regular thing. Shame as it is a fantastic trip and worth the hefty (for Vietnam) price.
drawbacks: Driver was aggressive and demanding tips
Driver was rude and only knew 2 words in English
practical_tips: Be prepared for aggressive drivers demanding tips

author: Tourist66989104117
title: Service Too bad
original_content: The scene doesn't say anything but the service is too bad compared to Trang An and other places. The boat driver coaxing customers to buy products and take photos made me very uncomfortable, not to mention that when I got there, he turned on the mode to ask for a tip. Bo is a tourist who voluntarily gives as thanks, not under the obligation to give, causing loss of sympathy for tourists. The Management Board needs to reconsider this. Tourists have spent money on tickets that include everything, and the tickets are not cheap. I went once and was asked for it and it was very uncomfortable, I won't go back again
drawbacks: Service is too bad compared to Trang An and other places
Boat driver coaxing customers to buy products and take photos made me very uncomfortable
practical_tips: Don't go if you don't want to be asked for tips
Be prepared for aggressive sales tactics

author: Manou S
title: this experience was very different from the other tours in vietnam
original_content: because everyone recommended the boat tour, we did it. it is quite an expensive tour for vietnam for the time of 1 hour. it started with many boats approaching us and wanting to take pictures of us for 1 dollar. although we refused, we were harassed further. the trip through the short caves was nice. at some point the boat driver unpacked pictures and wanted to sell them to us for twice as much as we saw in the souvenir stores. we politely declined and she hassled us and got angry. during almost the entire tour, the boat driver spoke very loudly on the phone. on the way back she said several times that we had to tip her afterwards. that was the only english word she knew. all in all it was a tiring and disappointing trip. i would recommend doing the boat trip in trang an. the scenery is nicer there too.
drawbacks: Harassed by boat drivers for taking pictures
Boat driver spoke loudly on the phone
highlights: Trip through short caves was nice
Scenery is nicer in Trang An
practical_tips: Go to Trang An for better scenery
Be prepared for aggressive sales tactics

author: HkkS
title: Pleasant Ride with Good Nature.
original_content: Boat rides can be boring if you are not fond of nature.  1 hour for 2 ways ride. The ride was okay, don't meet any persistence seller on the ride. The view in December was not great but still good, not many boats so you can enjoy nature more.Some captains will volunteer to take your photos so tip them well. YES !! TIP THEM WELL.  I hate giving tip but this one. IT IS A MUST.
drawbacks: boring if you are not fond of nature
view in December was not great
highlights: captains will volunteer to take your photos

author: Miguel E
title: Beautiful bay
original_content: It is wonderful to take a rowing boat ride, certainly moved with the feet of the rowers, for an hour and a half, with rice fields on both sides, and crossing two caves along the way, which make the journey grandiose, ending in a cove in which to visit a small Buddhist temple, and return to the exit.It is very worth enjoying this show

author: Mazion J
title: Boat trip with super friendly local people
original_content: Nice and amazing place in Vietnam. It is one of beautiful destinations in Vietnam. Maybe better than Trang An

author: Tracey H
title: Stunning scenery.
original_content: The boat trip is set in  beautiful surroundings. The limestone mountains are stunning. We were lucky to go at a time when it was relatively quiet. It was overcast but warm and I think it was the perfect weather as two hours in hot sun doesn’t appeal to me. The only thing that spoilt it for us was the pressure to tip & buy photos. It states on the regulations that rowers shouldn’t sell things or ask for tips. We would have been more likely to tip if not constantly asked for one. We bought one book of photos but the vendor literally followed us on her bike trying to get us to buy more. Don’t let this put you off though as it really is quite amazing scenery.
practical_tips: go at a relatively quiet time

author: Mumma&Co
title: Do not miss doing this!!
original_content: Incredible,  absolutely loved it!! Breathtaking scenery!! Busy but we still found it serene & tranquil. Pain being asked for a tip, asked to buy souvenirs,  asked to pay to get photo taken but all part of it.
drawbacks: Pain being asked for a tip
Asked to pay to get photo taken

author: egwanderlust
title: A Magical Experience
original_content: The Tam Cốc area was a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Being surrounded by the limestone cliffs we were in awe. The inside of the caves was gigantic, and felt like they went for miles. The talented boat rowers added more to this experience as we were amazed by their rowing skills. 2 hours - all by their feet! Their leg muscles must be crazy.Make sure to tip the rowers. This is how they make their living. Our driver was a sweetheart, and kept us smiling - despite the language barrier. Although this attraction was touristy it was relaxing and beautiful.
practical_tips: go with a driver who is a sweetheart

author: DomCanada
title: Best part of Ninh Binh
original_content: We loved the boat ride. Super relaxing, beautiful views, travelling under the caves. A must do. Best part of Ninh Binh in our opinion.

author: SFGourmet
title: Gorgeous Lime Stone Formation - the River version of Halong Bay
original_content: Take the 90 minute row boat ride on the river and admire the gorgeous view of the lime stone hills and caves. The scenery here is just as pretty as Halong Bay. The difference is that Tam Coc boat ride allows you to be up close to the formation whereas Halong allows you to see the formations in a larger scale.A must do in Hanoi
practical_tips: Take the 90 minute row boat ride

author: Robert F
title: Nice to do
original_content: Very nice to do. We even saw some monkey from afar. Their are more options to go. Did others as well. They sell combination tickets. Be aware of that. If you get them, use them.
practical_tips: use combination tickets if you get them

author: Anmar68
title: Small and touristy town with nice sights
original_content: Tam Coc is a nice, but touristy village. You can go boating from the center (on the lake) and there are plenty of bicycles (50 dong) and scooters (100 dong) for rent. We did the boat trip in Trang An after the negative reviews on Tripadvisor. Was busy, but fine. Route 2 is the most popular, then you go in a procession across the river. We chose route 1: 9 caves and 3 temples and the most quiet route. Your boat must have at least 3 people, so we had to wait a while for more people who wanted to do that route. All in all, it took 3 hours to sail on the river and through the caves. No sellers along the way and the rower was not fussy about the time, so you could visit and view the temples in peace.Cycling from Tam Coc to Trang An is about 12 km inland. And you will pass the rice fields if you set Google Maps to walking. Bin Dinh is a bit further away so we did that by scooter. Partly the same way. Also doable.Beautiful mountains here.Tam Coc itself has many homestays, hotels and restaurants. It is also a real backpacking destination. Delicious coffee available at Duc's Coffee, near the lake in the quiet part (just after the entrance to Emeralda resort). Food looked good there too.
drawbacks: Had to wait a while for more people
highlights: Plenty of bicycles and scooters for rent
Could visit and view the temples in peace

author: Skram66
title: Smaller district within Ninh Binh: highly recommend!
original_content: Fab, great, beautiful, quieter, local, nice, wonderful place where you can set your base from where to explore many places. Suggest Amanda Villas as a terrific place to stay, which is a 10minute walk into the touristy centre. Amanda Villas can kit you out with moped &/cycles. Loved Tam Coc area.
practical_tips: Suggest Amanda Villas as a terrific place to stay
Amanda Villas can kit you out with moped &/cycles

author: P J
title: Stay for a few days. Wonderful area
original_content: Most people seem to visit the area on day trips from Hanoi but my advice would be to catch the train or get a Grab and come and stay for a few days. There's loads to see and lots to do. We stayed at a homestay for 4 nights and like most of them in the area they provided free push bikes. You can safely cycle to many of the local sites but I'd recommend getting a driver for the day (about $60 dollars) and visiting 3 or 4 of the main sites. We went to Trang An for our boat trip and took route 3. It was stunning and absolutely amazing, there was no hassle and no one trying to sell you anything.5 ⭐Tam Coc Horizon bungalows for accommodation.Trang An for boat trip.Cycle to Mua CaveCycle to various temples and pagodas.
highlights: no one trying to sell you anything
practical_tips: catch the train or get a Grab
get a driver for the day
cycle to many of the local sites

author: maughams
title: A lovely procession walk
original_content: We left from the main pier, early around 9 a.m. to avoid the crowds. The walk is magnificent, rocky peaks, rice fields, water lily fields, three caves under which the boat passes. everything invites you to daydream along the water, unfortunately, the boats follow each other in procession and our boat was accompanied throughout the journey by another boat and the two rowers were particularly happy to meet again because they chatted without interruption during the one and a half hour walk, so for the peace of mind, the reverie and the stroll, it was a bit of a miss. On the other hand, we escaped the forced purchases, we were not solicited. Our rower nevertheless expressed her dissatisfaction with the tip given.
drawbacks: boats follow each other in procession

author: cramac
title: Beautiful country
original_content: I didn't do the classic boat excursion because it was closed for holidays, but I stayed one night and Vincenzo visited the surroundings which I review separately. However, the country is very beautiful and hospitable. I slept in a Homestay which was the best quality accommodation of my trip. The mountain landscapes that overlook the rice fields, visible even with a short walk, are fabulous
drawbacks: the classic boat excursion was closed for holidays
highlights: the country is very beautiful and hospitable
the Homestay was the best quality accommodation of my trip
practical_tips: go early to see the boat excursion

author: Mike and Liz
title: 2-3 days in Tam Coc.
original_content: Nice place for 2-3 days. Came here for boat trips but they were closed - which ended up being a good thing as we did boat trip at Trans An which was better by most accounts (very busy with Vietnamese tourists but that added to the experience). I expect Tam Coc village would have been a lot busier with busses etc had the boat trips ben running there. TC good place to hire bike and just explore. Trang An was about 15 minutes away on a scooter, and the hill with the dragon on about 10 minutes.Enjoyed eating at the TPub for a fix of great western food for a change from local food.
highlights: Boat trip at Trans An was better
Good place to hire bike and explore
practical_tips: Go to Trang An for a boat trip
Hire a bike to explore Tam Coc village

author: 4boysdad
title: relaxing boat ride through stunning scenery
original_content: On a day trip that included the ruins of Hoa Lu we also did a 2 hour boat trip of Tam Coc described as the Ha Long Bay on land.  Tickets must be bought before boarding the boats which can take up to 4 passengers.  There are three route options and our guide recommended route 3 to avoid periods bent over as boats travelled through long caves.  Along the river there are several temples and each has a small market offering food/drinks, toilets and souvenirs. Note July is very hot and humid and the best cover is an umbrella. Fans are also essential.  Seats are hard and can be comfortable towards the end of the trip so take a small extra cushions if you have a back issue.Boarding and leaving the boat is tricky so this may not suit people with mobility or balance problems but it is a beautiful experience and the temples are stunning.
drawbacks: Tickets must be bought before boarding the boats
Boarding and leaving the boat is tricky
practical_tips: take a small extra cushions if you have a back issue
use an umbrella and fans for heat and humidity

author: André K
title: Stunning
original_content: This is one of the most beautiful places I have visited . The natural beauty of this area is stunning and the river boat ride was so relaxing. This is a must do if you love nature and beautiful nature landscapes.

author: TravelingFool88005
title: Cool experience
original_content: his is a beautiful ride.  The most interesting thing about this trip is the rowers use their feet to paddle.  You get your own boat-2 people.  If you only have time to do one, do the Trang an.
highlights: rowers use their feet to paddle
practical_tips: do the Trang an if you only have time to do one

author: Mint P
title: Tam Coc, Ninh Binh - a place we should visit one time
original_content: The real scene is even more magnificent than what I saw in films. Last March, I went to Tam Coc, Ninh Binh with my friends and we took a lot of pretty pictures of nature. Hope to come back in one day^^

author: Rita Pedro
title: Amazing landscape!
original_content: We did not arrange a tour. We made our way there and bought the ticket there. It is very easy to do so and there is no need for pre-booking.Tam Coc is one of the most beautiful places I have seen. I highly recommend it!There is a boat tour that is very nice. You can chose to stop and see a small pagoda and go up a king kong looking 'mountain' to see the views from above. These options are not always offered, so ask to do so!We also went to the Mua cave and the dragon Mountain that is in the same area. It is beautiful and I highly recommend to visit all in the same day.
practical_tips: ask to stop at pagoda and mountain
visit all in the same day

author: Gina L
title: Beautiful scenery, greedy people
original_content: Beautiful scenery, greedy peopleThe landscape along the way is beautiful, the boat is also hard, but forcing spending is actually too disappointing and disgusting.The cruise boat will start with a camera boat, if you agree to buy a photo he will start screaming around the sky for 500,000Don ten photos, waiting for you to hit the price, I later bought eight photos for half the price of 250,000 but I still feel losing.At the end of the boat, there is a boat that sells snacks, and she will ask you to help the hard boat to buy some comfort (but how can she buy more than us), this trip we spent 200,000 (remember to discuss the price)On the way back the boat will also stop to sell the paintings (2 300,000) but we didn't buy, my patience is running out.Finally I gave the boat to the little fee she was not satisfied, and asked if I could give the whole number to the multi-point.Really too greedy. However, the scenery is beautiful, but for the first time I wanted this trip to end soon 🙂

author: Lucas
title: Scummy scammers.
original_content: What a scummy bunch of scammers.We took this boat tour through the river and three caves. Before turning back after the third cave, our ‘driver’ stopped beside a woman on another rowing boat selling drinks and snacks. Following this, she forced us to try and buy drinks and snacks putting them on our laps, the young woman I stated we buy these refreshments for ‘our poor tired driver who’s taken us 70km’.She chose two loads of mangos and drinks which I knew this tiny little lady won’t have all of it. To this, I only had 100 VD in cash, so I said I have no more money. Me being kind, I said “no worries the driver can have the refreshments I’ll pay for her”. This young woman took back our cans of coke which we needed in 40 degree heat but let the ‘poor little lady’ driver keep her refreshments..Low and behold as I turned around she had given these refreshments back to the seller behind our backs!This beautiful scenic tour ending in a scam. These people have zero respect for others and see tourist like scum. It feels rather hypocritical how they preach peace and love and respect for their religion yet behave like this towards others. I hope Karma comes back to get them. Apart from the beauty of this county, there is no way I’d ever want to visit this country again. Because of the amounts of scams that happen, they take advantage of tourists. The ‘little old lady’ had a check to still ask for a tip. To which I said NO we paid for your lunch and I clearly said you’ve given it back I gestured to her so she understood what I was saying. From the beginning she said she spoke a little English.. funnily enough she forgot a single word once I told her how awful they were. The other scams on this tour are the pictures they try and sell you. They take quite a few and then say there’s better ones upping the price. They sell different junk in boxes too along the way and give them to the other drivers on the return. Say NO NO NO if you do this tour. * I’ve been told that the money from the refreshments scam gets split between driver and seller. What a bunch of immoral crooks.One of the scammers in this photo.
drawbacks: Forced to buy drinks and snacks
Scams on the tour, including selling pictures and junk
practical_tips: Say NO to buying drinks and snacks
Be cautious of scams on the tour

author: Shelley M
title: Go for the scenery
original_content: My family loved Tam Coc.  We did the boat ride at Trang An mainly due to reviews and don't regret that decision.  Tam Coc area is just so lovely and scenic.  Its not hard to find a bicycle and ride around and enjoy at your own pace without being harassed.  Do your homework and enjoy. Lots of little shops and homestays.  A group of women were practicing a dance or maybe it was just as exercise class, but we enjoyed watching them.  Didn't have the co ordination in join in.  A highlight in Vietnam and I really hope they don't over tourist this place and destroy the natural beauty.
highlights: enjoy at your own pace without being harassed
practical_tips: enjoy at your own pace without being harassed

author: Jaroslav Nečas
title: Nice part of Vietnam
original_content: I have spend there 3 days and it's probably the part of Vietnam I enjoyed the most. Nature there is spectacular, hills, rivers, caves pagodas and overall religious places. Everyone could there what he wants to. I encourage everyone to spend there few days. I was accommodated in family which did perfect service for me. Renting bike, motorbike, doing the laundry and even finding bus to leave..
highlights: Everyone could there what he wants to

author: Batis
title: Amazing Tam Coc
original_content: Beautiful time we had! The boat ride was 1.5 hours and our Boat lady was an expert one. We were led to  the 3 different caves which is part of the  long stretch of the  river Ngo Dong while our lady  gently rowed for us.  We were in awe enjoying this  beautiful site and nature's  wonder. Though we had the full whole day trip, i think we'll go back again 🥰 It helped us to  relax our mind and allowed us to inhale the pure air around the pollution free site.

author: Merleloves2travel
title: Beautiful tourist trap
original_content: Went with my hubby and 3 year old with a tour. It’s very easy to get to the ticket office and book your own ticket. No queues at all. The boat trip was safe at took approximately an hour. The scenery is beautiful. However it’s a tourist trap. The boat purposely takes you and stops at some ladies selling snacks. They are very pushy. They guilt you into buying for the boat man. Anyway after a wonderful ride we were cornered  and rudely asked for a tip. Also they demand for a specific tip amount and are not satisfied with small amounts. Besides rowing the boat, we were not even given a smile. Anyway maybe it’s their culture. I recommend tam foc if you can tolerate the rudeness

author: Leannie
title: Nice but not as stunning as Trang An
original_content: We were a family of 4 doing the tam coc boat trip, and as westerners we had two boats of two, unlike Trang An which allow 4 per boat.It was easy enough to buy our tickets and there was no waiting round for the boat, we opted to set off at 10am to avoid the hot port of the day. Our boat driver was certainly a chatty one! The tour is about 1.30hr which I think is about right seeing as there are no stops. The boat was marginally more comfortable than the trang an boats but both would not go amiss cushions! You go up and down the same stretch and through some small caves.The turning point has boat sellers, watch out here, we said we didn't want to buy anything having just had breakfast and she said what about a drink for your driver, then proceeded to pack up a bundle of drinks and snacks for him and tried to charge us a 100k, even with a mark up those items in a shop would cost about 20k, plus we suspected that the driver probably wouldn't even consume them and they would get handed back to the seller later on. Therefore we declined and told the driver he could have the 100k as a tip instead which he clearly preferred.
drawbacks: Boat sellers tried to sell us drinks and snacks at an inflated price
Driver tried to charge us 100k for drinks and snacks
Suspected the driver wouldn't consume the drinks and snacks
highlights: Boat was marginally more comfortable than Trang An boats
Tour was about 1.30hr and had no stops
practical_tips: Avoid buying drinks and snacks from boat sellers
Consider tipping the driver instead of buying them drinks and snacks

author: Craig R
title: Vietnam Holiday 2023
original_content: This was part of our tour itinerary so there was no haggling for price or tipping at the end of the boat trip. The river gets very crowded with sampans, but the scenery is fantastic. You go through 3 caves, and then turn around to come back. However, at the turn around point there are boats selling drinks and trinkets, and they won't let you go unless you buy something. So, I suggest you take some small denomination notes with you as they won't have change and buy a drink. it is interesting watching them row with their feet.A great trip well worth it. Remember only one gets in and out of the boat at a time, unless you want to get very wet.
drawbacks: boats selling drinks and trinkets won't let you go unless you buy something
getting very wet if multiple people get in/out at once
highlights: interesting watching them row with their feet
practical_tips: buy a drink at the turn around point

author: Sambuca1979
title: Paradise
original_content: It was one of my most beautiful excursions around the world! Among the rice fields, in a surreal silence .. boating between the spectacle of nature. It deserves once in a lifetime to live an emotion like this.

author: Elisabeth M
title: To avoid, such a pity...
original_content: Very agressive people asking tips all the tour. You ll be asked to pay extra from the beginning till the end.  Be also aware the fee for the boat is double than announced on the panel.

author: fal3
title: Go to Trang An instead!
original_content: The scenery is nice but it’s heavily polluted by infrastructure. Don’t go for a boat tour here. Trang An is 100 times better, there’s a reason this isn’t part of the UNESCO site. It’s a decent place to walk around however.
drawbacks: Don't go for a boat tour here
it's not part of the UNESCO site
practical_tips: Don't go for a boat tour here

author: Inma P
title: Good.
original_content: You are taken by boat along the river and next to it you see different houses and at the end you pass through some limestone rock caves until again you go outside and there they turn around and go to other caves. The best is the scenery. King Kon's film was shot there. in October you don't see rice fields because it's already picked
drawbacks: You don't see rice fields in October
highlights: King Kon's film was shot there
practical_tips: Go in a different month to see rice fields

author: Foothill
title: Explore by bicycle
original_content: Tam Coc is surrounded by exceptional beauty, best experienced by bicycle.  Explore the roads leading out of town in multiple directions.  Surprises abound, in the fields, mountains and waterways.  No need to sign up for an organized tour or guide.  This is a place for serendipity.
practical_tips: no need to sign up for an organized tour or guide

author: sofia
title: Nice trip
original_content: Nice placeNice river but I had my tour guide said time nicest on May or September:(But this time still nice trip with me :)

author: helen12397
title: Don't bother.
original_content: Boring with pushy locals trying to sell you crap.It's so worth going 10kms further and an extra 100,000vnd to Trang An boat tours which is fantastic.
drawbacks: pushy locals trying to sell you crap
highlights: Trang An boat tours which is fantastic

author: M N
title: Aggressive Local Con Artist - Multiple Scam Attempts. Too Expensive.
original_content: Upon arrival to the check in, we were schooled at the stark difference in the written price that was scribbled on a piece of paper, verses the billboard advertisement that was 10 feet to the side of it. With a price paid of $390,000 Dong, this is an expensive activity by itself in Vietnam. We got in the boat, and off we went with a quiet lady who began rowing with her feet. This was way cool! She began hollering in Vietnamese at the passing boats, which we took as small talk at first, with normal scoffing and bickering to passing boats and even locals on land. Our boat driver stopped the boat in the middle of the tour to get some mangoes from another boat driver. Interesting we thought. After paddling a long time with her feet, going through some amazing sights, we also saw a lot of littering and disappointment. After going under several wonderful caves, we came to a halt with no explanation. A con boat came up and tried making us purchase food and drink for the tired boat driver. The price started at $150,000 Dong and went down to $80,000 Dong for some mangos and a soda that the lady con artist wanted us to pay for, for the boat driver. When we refused, the con boat paddled away, but the boat driver refused to paddle - we were stranded and she said “ too tired” implying she was too tired to paddle away. After some time and puzzled waiting, she began paddling back. When coming up to the dock, she stopped again and demanded a tip. We tipped $100,000 Dong but she looked at it and requested double, $200,000 Dong. We refused to pay and finally she towed ashore.Never again! Friendly advice. Save your money and go to Tra Ang boat tour it is 200 percent better in every way.
drawbacks: Con boat tried making us purchase food and drink
Boat driver refused to paddle, leaving us stranded
highlights: Quiet lady rowing with her feet
practical_tips: Save your money and go to Tra Ang boat tour

author: Pat
title: Ripp-off
original_content: We did the boats tour. The whole experience was super disappointing. 1) it is insanely expensive (we paid 18$ for the two of us)2) unfriendly people driving the boat: our guide tried to sell us some pictures and, different to the city, you can not walk away if you are on a boat on a 2 h trip3) after harassing us, the tour guide asked us for a tip. Since we felt very bad throughout the trip, we did not pay it and were scolded put4) 2h boats trip is just super boring. There are a lot of tourists on their phones, understandably.5) in the middle if the tour, there are other merchants who pressure you to buy something. Our tour guide even drove us to the merchants and did not turn away, although we told her we were not interested6) boring caves: the caves were not worth a visitThis is one more attraction where you as a tourist are just seen as walking money.  Overall, we saw an inverse correlation between entry prices and services offered. The more expensive, the shittier it is. Frustrated because od the experience, my bf and I decided to do a trip through Ninh Binh on our own and not engage in any touristy activity. We found a temple which was free of entry and was the nicest temple you will see in Vietnam! They are Chua Ky Lan and Thap Chua Bac.Please save your money and time and skip this!
practical_tips: go to Chua Ky Lan and Thap Chua Bac instead

author: SILKE R
title: Nice landscape
original_content: Very nice landscape and nace People. We really e enjoyed the stay.Going by bien enjoying the nice views or going by boat was really worth it.

author: Miguel M
title: Tam coc is beautiful but lot of scammers in tourist areas
original_content: Tam coc has majestic landscapes and pagodas.However tam coc municipality support scammers.They do nothing to prevent scam parkings. Never park anywhere where they yell at you, whistle, tell you road is closed or that you cannot entry, etc.. these are just SC*mb*GS trying to rip you off.For the boat trip I advise you to do it in Trang An (they have it very organized, rowers are very polite and friendly). They will not ask you for a tip. But most people will give them at the end because you realize they did a great job during three hours.  In Tam Coc, is a different story, they will try to scam you: asking for tips consistently, and they will tell you to give them more... Other "partners in crime" will approach your boat asking to buy something for you. If you refuse they will ask you to buy something for rower. And will not let you return until you buy something or you spend several minutes arguing.
highlights: Organized boat trip in Trang An
practical_tips: Do not park where they yell at you, whistle, tell you road is closed or that you cannot entry
Do the boat trip in Trang An
Do not give tips to rowers in Tam Coc

author: Kinga
title: Rude locals
original_content: The płace is really beautiful but the local people destroy all the charm of the area. They are rude and they force you to give them money. The locals treated us as the walking wallets. At the end of the kayak trip they insisted on buying things and at the end the rower repeated obsessively <tip, tip, give me tip!!!>, we were shocked. We gave him 10K even though I didnt want to give him anything because of his rude behaviour. He took the money and he was very nervous that we didnt give him more.During the kayak trip the women on the other kayaks proposed obsessively to do us some photos - of course to pay for it. They do not understand the word <no>.I’ve never met the ruder local people. Rude, insisting and making the trip annoying.
drawbacks: They force you to give them money
The rower was obsessive about tips
